18 — DPSEQUENCES.JAVA

Sequences & Strings

Two sequences give a prefix table dp[i][j]. One sequence with a pairwise condition gives LIS-style dp or the O(n log n) tails array. Palindromes use interval dp or center expansion.

PatternUse caseComplexity
LISLongest chain, each element larger than the previousO(n log n)
LCS / edit distanceTwo strings, match or edit prefixesO(nm)
PalindromesInterval dp or expand around a centerO(n^2)
MatchingWildcard, regex, interleave, distinct subsequencesO(nm)
DPSequences.java
LIS (both forms), count of LIS, envelopes, LCS, edit distance, palindromes, distinct subsequences, word break, wildcard, regex, interleave
O(nm)
  • Longest increasing chain? → Tails array with binary search, O(n log n) lengthOfLIS
  • two sequences, keep order, match characters. dp[i][j] over prefixes. longestCommonSubsequence
  • Two strings, edits or common parts? → Prefix table dp[i][j] minDistance
  • Can the string be segmented into dictionary words? → dp over prefix length wordBreak
  • Does a pattern with wildcards match? → Prefix table; star means skip or consume isMatchRegex
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class DPSequences {

    // ---------- LIS in O(n log n) (LC 300) ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: longest chain where each element must exceed the previous (subsequence, order kept).
    // tails[i] = smallest possible tail of an increasing subsequence of length i + 1.
    static int lengthOfLIS(int[] nums) {
        int[] tails = new int[nums.length];
        int size = 0;
        for (int x : nums) {
            int lo = 0, hi = size;
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
                if (tails[mid] < x) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
            }
            tails[lo] = x;
            if (lo == size) size++;
        }
        return size;
    }

    // O(n^2) reference form: dp[i] = longest increasing subsequence ending at i
    static int lengthOfLISQuadratic(int[] nums) {
        int best = 0;
        int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
            dp[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (nums[j] < nums[i]) dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            best = Math.max(best, dp[i]);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Number of LIS (LC 673): carry a count next to each length
    static int findNumberOfLIS(int[] nums) {
        int n = nums.length, best = 0, res = 0;
        int[] len = new int[n], cnt = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            len[i] = 1;
            cnt[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                if (nums[j] >= nums[i]) continue;
                if (len[j] + 1 > len[i]) { len[i] = len[j] + 1; cnt[i] = cnt[j]; }
                else if (len[j] + 1 == len[i]) cnt[i] += cnt[j];
            }
            if (len[i] > best) { best = len[i]; res = cnt[i]; }
            else if (len[i] == best) res += cnt[i];
        }
        return res;
    }

    // Russian Doll Envelopes (LC 354): sort width asc, height DESC, then LIS on heights
    static int maxEnvelopes(int[][] env) {
        Arrays.sort(env, (a, b) -> a[0] != b[0] ? Integer.compare(a[0], b[0]) : Integer.compare(b[1], a[1]));
        int[] h = new int[env.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < env.length; i++) h[i] = env[i][1];
        return lengthOfLIS(h);
    }

    // ---------- LCS (LC 1143) ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: two sequences, keep order, match characters. dp[i][j] over prefixes.
    static int longestCommonSubsequence(String a, String b) {
        int n = a.length(), m = b.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
                dp[i][j] = a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1) ? dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1 : Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
        return dp[n][m];
    }

    // ---------- Edit Distance (LC 72): insert / delete / replace ----------
    static int minDistance(String a, String b) {
        int n = a.length(), m = b.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) dp[0][j] = j;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
                dp[i][j] = a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1)
                        ? dp[i - 1][j - 1]
                        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i - 1][j - 1], Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]));
        return dp[n][m];
    }

    // ---------- Palindromes ----------
    // Longest Palindromic Subsequence (LC 516): interval dp[i][j]
    static int longestPalindromeSubseq(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            dp[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++)
                dp[i][j] = s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j) ? dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 2 : Math.max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
        }
        return n == 0 ? 0 : dp[0][n - 1];
    }

    // Longest Palindromic Substring (LC 5): expand around every center, O(n^2) time, O(1) space
    static String longestPalindrome(String s) {
        int bs = 0, be = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < s.length(); c++) {
            for (int w = 0; w < 2; w++) { // w = 0 odd length, w = 1 even length
                int l = c, r = c + w;
                while (l >= 0 && r < s.length() && s.charAt(l) == s.charAt(r)) { l--; r++; }
                if (r - l - 1 > be - bs) { bs = l + 1; be = r; }
            }
        }
        return s.substring(bs, be);
    }

    // Palindromic Substrings (LC 647)
    static int countSubstrings(String s) {
        int count = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < s.length(); c++) {
            for (int w = 0; w < 2; w++) {
                int l = c, r = c + w;
                while (l >= 0 && r < s.length() && s.charAt(l) == s.charAt(r)) { count++; l--; r++; }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    // ---------- Distinct Subsequences (LC 115): dp[j] = ways to form t[0..j) ----------
    static int numDistinct(String s, String t) {
        int[] dp = new int[t.length() + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray())
            for (int j = t.length(); j >= 1; j--)
                if (c == t.charAt(j - 1)) dp[j] += dp[j - 1];
        return dp[t.length()];
    }

    // ---------- Word Break (LC 139): dp[i] = prefix of length i is breakable ----------
    static boolean wordBreak(String s, List<String> dict) {
        Set<String> set = new HashSet<>(dict);
        int maxLen = 0;
        for (String w : dict) maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, w.length());
        boolean[] dp = new boolean[s.length() + 1];
        dp[0] = true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= s.length(); i++) {
            for (int j = Math.max(0, i - maxLen); j < i; j++) {
                if (dp[j] && set.contains(s.substring(j, i))) { dp[i] = true; break; }
            }
        }
        return dp[s.length()];
    }

    // ---------- Wildcard Matching (LC 44): '?' one char, '*' any sequence ----------
    static boolean isMatchWildcard(String s, String p) {
        int n = s.length(), m = p.length();
        boolean[][] dp = new boolean[n + 1][m + 1];
        dp[0][0] = true;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (p.charAt(j - 1) == '*') dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char pc = p.charAt(j - 1);
                if (pc == '*') dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1] || dp[i - 1][j];
                else if (pc == '?' || pc == s.charAt(i - 1)) dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        return dp[n][m];
    }

    // ---------- Regular Expression Matching (LC 10): '.' any char, 'x*' zero or more x ----------
    static boolean isMatchRegex(String s, String p) {
        int n = s.length(), m = p.length();
        boolean[][] dp = new boolean[n + 1][m + 1];
        dp[0][0] = true;
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) if (p.charAt(j - 1) == '*') dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char pc = p.charAt(j - 1);
                if (pc == '*') {
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 2]; // zero copies of the preceding element
                    char prev = p.charAt(j - 2);
                    if (prev == '.' || prev == s.charAt(i - 1)) dp[i][j] |= dp[i - 1][j]; // one more copy
                } else if (pc == '.' || pc == s.charAt(i - 1)) {
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][m];
    }

    // ---------- Interleaving String (LC 97) ----------
    static boolean isInterleave(String a, String b, String c) {
        int n = a.length(), m = b.length();
        if (n + m != c.length()) return false;
        boolean[] dp = new boolean[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) { dp[j] = true; continue; }
                boolean fromA = i > 0 && dp[j] && a.charAt(i - 1) == c.charAt(i + j - 1);
                boolean fromB = j > 0 && dp[j - 1] && b.charAt(j - 1) == c.charAt(i + j - 1);
                dp[j] = fromA || fromB;
            }
        }
        return dp[m];
    }

    // ---------- Longest Common SUBSTRING-style: Maximum Length of Repeated Subarray (LC 718) ----------
    static int findLength(int[] a, int[] b) {
        int[] dp = new int[b.length + 1];
        int best = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
            for (int j = b.length; j >= 1; j--) {
                dp[j] = a[i - 1] == b[j - 1] ? dp[j - 1] + 1 : 0; // contiguous: reset on mismatch
                best = Math.max(best, dp[j]);
            }
        }
        return best;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Russian Doll: sort width ascending and height DESCENDING so equal widths cannot chain.
  2. Subsequence means order kept, substring means contiguous: contiguous resets to 0 on mismatch.
  3. Regex star: zero copies is dp[i][j-2]; one more copy needs the preceding char to match.

19 — DPGRIDINTERVAL.JAVA

Grid & Interval DP

Grids depend on up/left (or backward for dungeon-style). Interval dp answers a range [i, j] by trying every split k; loop by length. In burst balloons, k is the LAST item processed.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Grid pathsRight/down moves, count or min/max path sumO(mn)
Max squareMin of three neighbors plus oneO(mn)
IntervalMatrix chain, burst balloons, cut stick, strange printerO(n^3)
Game dpScore difference the mover can forceO(n^2)
DPGridInterval.java
Unique paths, min path sum, triangle, maximal square, dungeon, cherry pickup II, burst balloons, matrix chain, cut stick, palindrome cuts, strange printer, stone game
O(n^3)
  • grid, move right/down only, count paths or min/max path sum. uniquePaths
  • Grid with right/down moves? → Row-rolling dp minPathSum
  • Answer for range [i, j] from splitting at k? → Interval dp, loop by length maxCoins
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class DPGridInterval {

    // ---------- Unique Paths (LC 62) ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: grid, move right/down only, count paths or min/max path sum.
    static int uniquePaths(int m, int n) {
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(dp, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j < n; j++) dp[j] += dp[j - 1];
        return dp[n - 1];
    }

    // Unique Paths II (LC 63): obstacles
    static int uniquePathsObstacles(int[][] g) {
        int n = g[0].length;
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        dp[0] = g[0][0] == 1 ? 0 : 1;
        for (int[] row : g)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (row[j] == 1) dp[j] = 0;
                else if (j > 0) dp[j] += dp[j - 1];
            }
        return dp[n - 1];
    }

    // Minimum Path Sum (LC 64)
    static int minPathSum(int[][] g) {
        int m = g.length, n = g[0].length;
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) dp[j] = g[0][0];
                else if (i == 0) dp[j] = dp[j - 1] + g[i][j];
                else if (j == 0) dp[j] = dp[j] + g[i][j];
                else dp[j] = Math.min(dp[j], dp[j - 1]) + g[i][j];
            }
        return dp[n - 1];
    }

    // Triangle (LC 120): bottom-up, one row
    static int minimumTotal(List<List<Integer>> t) {
        int n = t.size();
        int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) dp[j] = Math.min(dp[j], dp[j + 1]) + t.get(i).get(j);
        return dp[0];
    }

    // Maximal Square (LC 221): dp = side of largest square with bottom-right corner here
    static int maximalSquare(char[][] g) {
        int m = g.length, n = g[0].length, best = 0;
        int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (g[i - 1][j - 1] == '1') {
                    dp[i][j] = 1 + Math.min(dp[i - 1][j - 1], Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]));
                    best = Math.max(best, dp[i][j]);
                }
        return best * best;
    }

    // Dungeon Game (LC 174): run BACKWARD, min health needed to stand at each cell
    static int calculateMinimumHP(int[][] d) {
        int m = d.length, n = d[0].length;
        int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
        for (int[] r : dp) Arrays.fill(r, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        dp[m][n - 1] = dp[m - 1][n] = 1;
        for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; j--)
                dp[i][j] = Math.max(1, Math.min(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j + 1]) - d[i][j]);
        return dp[0][0];
    }

    // Cherry Pickup II (LC 1463): two walkers move row by row together; state = (col1, col2)
    static int cherryPickup2(int[][] g) {
        int m = g.length, n = g[0].length;
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] r : dp) Arrays.fill(r, Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2);
        dp[0][n - 1] = g[0][0] + g[0][n - 1];
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            int[][] nx = new int[n][n];
            for (int[] r : nx) Arrays.fill(r, Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2);
            for (int a = 0; a < n; a++)
                for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                    int best = Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2;
                    for (int da = -1; da <= 1; da++)
                        for (int db = -1; db <= 1; db++) {
                            int pa = a + da, pb = b + db;
                            if (pa >= 0 && pa < n && pb >= 0 && pb < n) best = Math.max(best, dp[pa][pb]);
                        }
                    nx[a][b] = best + g[i][a] + (a == b ? 0 : g[i][b]);
                }
            dp = nx;
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int[] r : dp) for (int v : r) ans = Math.max(ans, v);
        return ans;
    }

    // ===================== INTERVAL DP =====================
    // RECOGNIZE: answer for a range [i, j] built from splitting at k. Loop by LENGTH (or i descending).

    // Burst Balloons (LC 312): k is the LAST balloon burst in (i, j)
    static int maxCoins(int[] nums) {
        int n = nums.length;
        int[] a = new int[n + 2];
        a[0] = a[n + 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i + 1] = nums[i];
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        for (int len = 2; len <= n + 1; len++)
            for (int i = 0; i + len <= n + 1; i++) {
                int j = i + len;
                for (int k = i + 1; k < j; k++)
                    dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + a[i] * a[k] * a[j] + dp[k][j]);
            }
        return dp[0][n + 1];
    }

    // Matrix Chain Multiplication: dims[i-1] x dims[i] is matrix i
    static int matrixChainOrder(int[] dims) {
        int n = dims.length - 1;
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++)
            for (int i = 0; i + len - 1 < n; i++) {
                int j = i + len - 1;
                dp[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int k = i; k < j; k++)
                    dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + dp[k + 1][j] + dims[i] * dims[k + 1] * dims[j + 1]);
            }
        return n <= 1 ? 0 : dp[0][n - 1];
    }

    // Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick (LC 1547)
    static int minCostCutStick(int len, int[] cuts) {
        int m = cuts.length;
        int[] c = new int[m + 2];
        int[] sorted = cuts.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sorted);
        System.arraycopy(sorted, 0, c, 1, m);
        c[m + 1] = len;
        int[][] dp = new int[m + 2][m + 2];
        for (int d = 2; d <= m + 1; d++)
            for (int i = 0; i + d <= m + 1; i++) {
                int j = i + d;
                dp[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int k = i + 1; k < j; k++) dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + c[j] - c[i]);
            }
        return dp[0][m + 1];
    }

    // Palindrome Partitioning II (LC 132): min cuts
    static int minCutPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        boolean[][] pal = new boolean[n][n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int j = i; j < n; j++) pal[i][j] = s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j) && (j - i < 2 || pal[i + 1][j - 1]);
        int[] cut = new int[n];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (pal[0][j]) { cut[j] = 0; continue; }
            cut[j] = j;
            for (int i = 1; i <= j; i++) if (pal[i][j]) cut[j] = Math.min(cut[j], cut[i - 1] + 1);
        }
        return n == 0 ? 0 : cut[n - 1];
    }

    // Strange Printer (LC 664)
    static int strangePrinter(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            dp[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1] + 1;
                for (int k = i; k < j; k++)
                    if (s.charAt(k) == s.charAt(j)) dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + (k + 1 <= j - 1 ? dp[k + 1][j - 1] : 0));
            }
        }
        return dp[0][n - 1];
    }

    // Stone Game (LC 877 family): dp[i][j] = best score DIFFERENCE the mover can force on piles i..j
    static int stoneGameDiff(int[] p) {
        int n = p.length;
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            dp[i] = p[i];
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) dp[j] = Math.max(p[i] - dp[j], p[j] - dp[j - 1]);
        }
        return dp[n - 1];
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Dungeon must run backward: the minimum health needed depends on what comes AFTER.
  2. Burst balloons: think "last to burst" so the two sides become independent.
  3. Pad the array with sentinels (1 at both ends) instead of special-casing borders.

PatternUse caseComplexity

  • Count numbers up to N with a digit property? → Digit dp with tight flag countDigitOne
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class DPBitmaskDigit {

    // ---------- Bitmask DP: dp[mask] over a subset of <= ~20 items ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: n <= 20, "assign / partition / visit every item once".

    // Minimum Cost Assignment: cost[i][j] = worker i on task j, one each
    static int minCostAssignment(int[][] cost) {
        int n = cost.length;
        int[] dp = new int[1 << n];
        Arrays.fill(dp, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        dp[0] = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (dp[mask] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) continue;
            int worker = Integer.bitCount(mask); // next worker to place
            if (worker == n) continue;
            for (int t = 0; t < n; t++)
                if ((mask >> t & 1) == 0)
                    dp[mask | 1 << t] = Math.min(dp[mask | 1 << t], dp[mask] + cost[worker][t]);
        }
        return dp[(1 << n) - 1];
    }

    // Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets (LC 698): dp[mask] = sum mod target of items used, -1 if unreachable
    static boolean canPartitionKSubsets(int[] nums, int k) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int x : nums) sum += x;
        if (sum % k != 0) return false;
        int target = sum / k, n = nums.length;
        for (int x : nums) if (x > target) return false;
        int[] fill = new int[1 << n];
        Arrays.fill(fill, -1);
        fill[0] = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (fill[mask] < 0) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask >> i & 1) != 0 || fill[mask] + nums[i] > target) continue;
                fill[mask | 1 << i] = (fill[mask] + nums[i]) % target;
            }
        }
        return fill[(1 << n) - 1] == 0;
    }

    // Beautiful Arrangement (LC 526): position = popcount(mask) + 1
    static int countArrangement(int n) {
        int[] dp = new int[1 << n];
        dp[0] = 1;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (dp[mask] == 0) continue;
            int pos = Integer.bitCount(mask) + 1;
            for (int v = 1; v <= n; v++)
                if ((mask >> (v - 1) & 1) == 0 && (v % pos == 0 || pos % v == 0)) dp[mask | 1 << (v - 1)] += dp[mask];
        }
        return dp[(1 << n) - 1];
    }

    // Can I Win (LC 464): memo over the set of numbers already taken
    static boolean canIWin(int maxChoosable, int desiredTotal) {
        if (desiredTotal <= 0) return true;
        if (maxChoosable * (maxChoosable + 1) / 2 < desiredTotal) return false;
        return win(maxChoosable, desiredTotal, 0, new Boolean[1 << maxChoosable]);
    }

    // … win(): helper hidden
    private static boolean win(int max, int remain, int used, Boolean[] memo) {
        if (memo[used] != null) return memo[used];
        for (int i = 1; i <= max; i++) {
            if ((used >> (i - 1) & 1) != 0) continue;
            if (i >= remain || !win(max, remain - i, used | 1 << (i - 1), memo)) return memo[used] = true;
        }
        return memo[used] = false;
    }

    // Subset enumeration trick: for (sub = mask; sub > 0; sub = (sub - 1) & mask) -> total 3^n over all masks

    // ---------- Digit DP ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: "count numbers in [0, N] with a digit property". State = (pos, tight, started, property).

    // Number of Digit One (LC 233)
    static int countDigitOne(int n) {
        long count = 0;
        for (long p = 1; p <= n; p *= 10) {
            long high = n / (p * 10), cur = (n / p) % 10, low = n % p;
            if (cur == 0) count += high * p;
            else if (cur == 1) count += high * p + low + 1;
            else count += (high + 1) * p;
        }
        return (int) count;
    }

    // Numbers At Most N Given Digit Set (LC 902)
    static int atMostNGivenDigitSet(String[] digits, int n) {
        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        int L = s.length(), d = digits.length, res = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len < L; len++) res += (int) Math.pow(d, len);
        for (int i = 0; i < L; i++) {
            boolean sameDigit = false;
            for (String dg : digits) {
                if (dg.charAt(0) < s.charAt(i)) res += (int) Math.pow(d, L - i - 1);
                else if (dg.charAt(0) == s.charAt(i)) sameDigit = true;
            }
            if (!sameDigit) return res;
        }
        return res + 1; // n itself is buildable
    }

    // Generic digit DP: count x in [1, n] with no repeated digit (LC 1012)
    static int numDupDigitsAtMostN(int n) {
        return n - countUniqueDigits(n);
    }

    // … countUniqueDigits(): helper hidden
    private static int countUniqueDigits(int n) {
        char[] s = String.valueOf(n).toCharArray();
        Map<String, Integer> memo = new HashMap<>();
        return dig(s, 0, 0, true, false, memo);
    }

    // … dig(): helper hidden
    private static int dig(char[] s, int pos, int mask, boolean tight, boolean started, Map<String, Integer> memo) {
        if (pos == s.length) return started ? 1 : 0;
        String key = pos + "," + mask + "," + tight + "," + started;
        Integer c = memo.get(key);
        if (c != null) return c;
        int res = 0, lim = tight ? s[pos] - '0' : 9;
        for (int d = 0; d <= lim; d++) {
            boolean nt = tight && d == lim;
            if (!started && d == 0) res += dig(s, pos + 1, mask, nt, false, memo);
            else if ((mask >> d & 1) == 0) res += dig(s, pos + 1, mask | 1 << d, nt, true, memo);
        }
        memo.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Digit dp: tight is only true while every prefix digit equals the bound; started handles leading zeros.
  2. Subset enumeration sub = (sub - 1) & mask totals 3^n across all masks.
  3. Use Integer.bitCount(mask) as the implicit "how many placed" index.

// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class DPCombined {

    // ---------- DP + binary search: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling (LC 1235) ----------
    // dp[i] = best profit using the first i jobs (sorted by end). Binary-search the last compatible job.
    static int jobScheduling(int[] start, int[] end, int[] profit) {
        int n = start.length;
        Integer[] idx = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(idx, Comparator.comparingInt(i -> end[i]));
        int[] ends = new int[n], dp = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ends[i] = end[idx[i]];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int job = idx[i - 1];
            int lo = 0, hi = i - 1; // count of jobs among first i-1 with end <= start[job]
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
                if (ends[mid] <= start[job]) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
            }
            dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i - 1], dp[lo] + profit[job]);
        }
        return dp[n];
    }

    // ---------- DP + monotonic deque: sliding-window max over dp ----------
    // Constrained Subset Sum (LC 1425): pick a subsequence, adjacent picks at most k apart
    static int constrainedSubsetSum(int[] nums, int k) {
        Deque<Integer> dq = new ArrayDeque<>(); // indices, dp values decreasing
        int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
        int best = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
            while (!dq.isEmpty() && dq.peekFirst() < i - k) dq.pollFirst();
            dp[i] = nums[i] + (dq.isEmpty() ? 0 : Math.max(0, dp[dq.peekFirst()]));
            while (!dq.isEmpty() && dp[dq.peekLast()] <= dp[i]) dq.pollLast();
            dq.addLast(i);
            best = Math.max(best, dp[i]);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Jump Game VI (LC 1696): max score path with jumps of 1..k
    static int maxResult(int[] nums, int k) {
        int n = nums.length;
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        dp[0] = nums[0];
        Deque<Integer> dq = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dq.addLast(0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            while (dq.peekFirst() < i - k) dq.pollFirst();
            dp[i] = nums[i] + dp[dq.peekFirst()];
            while (!dq.isEmpty() && dp[dq.peekLast()] <= dp[i]) dq.pollLast();
            dq.addLast(i);
        }
        return dp[n - 1];
    }

    // ---------- Probability DP ----------
    // Knight Probability in Chessboard (LC 688)
    static double knightProbability(int n, int k, int row, int col) {
        int[][] mv = {{1, 2}, {2, 1}, {-1, 2}, {-2, 1}, {1, -2}, {2, -1}, {-1, -2}, {-2, -1}};
        double[][] cur = new double[n][n];
        cur[row][col] = 1;
        for (int s = 0; s < k; s++) {
            double[][] nx = new double[n][n];
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    if (cur[r][c] == 0) continue;
                    for (int[] m : mv) {
                        int nr = r + m[0], nc = c + m[1];
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < n && nc >= 0 && nc < n) nx[nr][nc] += cur[r][c] / 8.0;
                    }
                }
            cur = nx;
        }
        double sum = 0;
        for (double[] r : cur) for (double v : r) sum += v;
        return sum;
    }

    // New 21 Game (LC 837): dp[i] = P(reach score i), sliding window sum
    static double new21Game(int n, int k, int maxPts) {
        if (k == 0 || n >= k + maxPts) return 1.0;
        double[] dp = new double[n + 1];
        dp[0] = 1.0;
        double window = 1.0, ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = window / maxPts;
            if (i < k) window += dp[i]; else ans += dp[i];
            if (i - maxPts >= 0 && i - maxPts < k) window -= dp[i - maxPts];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    // ---------- Hash-map-state DP ----------
    // Longest Arithmetic Subsequence (LC 1027): dp[i][diff]
    static int longestArithSeqLength(int[] nums) {
        int n = nums.length, best = 2;
        if (n <= 2) return n;
        List<Map<Integer, Integer>> dp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> m = new HashMap<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int diff = nums[i] - nums[j];
                int len = dp.get(j).getOrDefault(diff, 1) + 1;
                m.merge(diff, len, Math::max);
                best = Math.max(best, len);
            }
            dp.add(m);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Memoized DFS on a DAG: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix (LC 329) ----------
    static int longestIncreasingPath(int[][] g) {
        int m = g.length, n = g[0].length, best = 0;
        int[][] memo = new int[m][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) best = Math.max(best, lip(g, i, j, memo));
        return best;
    }

    // … lip(): helper hidden
    private static int lip(int[][] g, int i, int j, int[][] memo) {
        if (memo[i][j] != 0) return memo[i][j];
        int best = 1;
        int[] d = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int r = i + d[k], c = j + d[k + 1];
            if (r >= 0 && r < g.length && c >= 0 && c < g[0].length && g[r][c] > g[i][j])
                best = Math.max(best, 1 + lip(g, r, c, memo));
        }
        return memo[i][j] = best;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. When transitions look at a sliding window of earlier dp values, reach for a monotonic deque before a segment tree.
  2. Longest increasing path needs no visited set: strictly increasing values make the graph a DAG.

DP: Hard Variants

  • Two walkers on one grid? → Step index + both rows cherryPickup

// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class DPVariants {
    // Framework reminder: state -> choice -> transition -> base -> order -> can the state shrink?

    // ---------- Frog Jump (LC 403): state = (stone, last jump); set of reachable jump sizes per stone ----------
    static boolean canCross(int[] stones) {
        Map<Integer, Set<Integer>> jumps = new HashMap<>();
        for (int s : stones) jumps.put(s, new HashSet<>());
        jumps.get(0).add(0);
        for (int s : stones)
            for (int k : jumps.get(s))
                for (int step = k - 1; step <= k + 1; step++)
                    if (step > 0 && jumps.containsKey(s + step)) jumps.get(s + step).add(step);
        return !jumps.get(stones[stones.length - 1]).isEmpty();
    }

    // ---------- Stone Game II (LC 1140): dp[i][M] = best stones the mover can take from piles i.. with limit M ----------
    static int stoneGameII(int[] piles) {
        int n = piles.length;
        int[] suffix = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) suffix[i] = suffix[i + 1] + piles[i];
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int m = 1; m <= n; m++) {
                if (i + 2 * m >= n) { dp[i][m] = suffix[i]; continue; } // can take everything left
                int best = 0;
                for (int x = 1; x <= 2 * m; x++) best = Math.max(best, suffix[i] - dp[i + x][Math.max(m, x)]); // total - opponent's best
                dp[i][m] = best;
            }
        return dp[0][1];
    }

    // ---------- Predict the Winner (LC 486): dp[l][r] = best score difference for the mover ----------
    static boolean predictTheWinner(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length;
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dp[i][i] = a[i];
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++)
            for (int l = 0; l + len - 1 < n; l++) {
                int r = l + len - 1;
                dp[l][r] = Math.max(a[l] - dp[l + 1][r], a[r] - dp[l][r - 1]);
            }
        return dp[0][n - 1] >= 0;
    }

    // ---------- Super Egg Drop (LC 887): dp[m][k] = max floors checkable with m moves and k eggs ----------
    static int superEggDrop(int eggs, int floors) {
        int[] dp = new int[eggs + 1];
        int moves = 0;
        while (dp[eggs] < floors) {
            moves++;
            for (int k = eggs; k >= 1; k--) dp[k] = dp[k] + dp[k - 1] + 1; // egg breaks (k-1) + survives (k) + this floor
        }
        return moves;
    }

    // ---------- Number of Dice Rolls With Target Sum (LC 1155) ----------
    static int numRollsToTarget(int dice, int faces, int target) {
        final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
        int[] dp = new int[target + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        for (int d = 1; d <= dice; d++) {
            int[] next = new int[target + 1];
            for (int s = 1; s <= target; s++)
                for (int f = 1; f <= faces && f <= s; f++) next[s] = (next[s] + dp[s - f]) % MOD;
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[target];
    }

    // ---------- Paint House II (LC 265): keep the two smallest previous costs so each row is O(k) ----------
    static int minCostII(int[][] costs) {
        int n = costs.length, k = costs[0].length;
        int min1 = 0, min2 = 0, idx1 = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int nm1 = Integer.MAX_VALUE, nm2 = Integer.MAX_VALUE, ni = -1;
            for (int c = 0; c < k; c++) {
                int cost = costs[i][c] + (c == idx1 ? min2 : min1);
                if (cost < nm1) { nm2 = nm1; nm1 = cost; ni = c; }
                else if (cost < nm2) nm2 = cost;
            }
            min1 = nm1; min2 = nm2; idx1 = ni;
        }
        return min1;
    }

    // ---------- Cherry Pickup (LC 741): two walkers go down together; state = (step, r1, r2) ----------
    static int cherryPickup(int[][] grid) {
        int n = grid.length, NEG = Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2;
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : dp) Arrays.fill(row, NEG);
        dp[0][0] = grid[0][0];
        for (int step = 1; step <= 2 * (n - 1); step++) {
            int[][] next = new int[n][n];
            for (int[] row : next) Arrays.fill(row, NEG);
            for (int r1 = Math.max(0, step - (n - 1)); r1 <= Math.min(n - 1, step); r1++)
                for (int r2 = r1; r2 <= Math.min(n - 1, step); r2++) {
                    int c1 = step - r1, c2 = step - r2;
                    if (grid[r1][c1] == -1 || grid[r2][c2] == -1) continue;
                    int best = Math.max(Math.max(dp[r1][r2], r1 > 0 ? dp[r1 - 1][r2] : NEG), Math.max(r2 > 0 ? dp[r1][r2 - 1] : NEG, r1 > 0 && r2 > 0 ? dp[r1 - 1][r2 - 1] : NEG));
                    if (best < 0) continue;
                    int gain = grid[r1][c1] + (r1 == r2 ? 0 : grid[r2][c2]); // same cell: count once
                    next[r1][r2] = best + gain;
                }
            dp = next;
        }
        return Math.max(0, dp[n - 1][n - 1]);
    }

    // ---------- Out of Boundary Paths (LC 576): dp over moves ----------
    static int findPaths(int m, int n, int maxMove, int startRow, int startCol) {
        final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
        int[][] dp = new int[m][n];
        dp[startRow][startCol] = 1;
        int out = 0;
        int[][] dirs = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};
        for (int move = 0; move < maxMove; move++) {
            int[][] next = new int[m][n];
            for (int r = 0; r < m; r++)
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    if (dp[r][c] == 0) continue;
                    for (int[] d : dirs) {
                        int nr = r + d[0], nc = c + d[1];
                        if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr >= m || nc >= n) out = (out + dp[r][c]) % MOD;
                        else next[nr][nc] = (next[nr][nc] + dp[r][c]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            dp = next;
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ---------- Domino and Tromino Tiling (LC 790): f(n) = 2 f(n-1) + f(n-3) ----------
    static int numTilings(int n) {
        final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
        if (n <= 2) return n;
        long a = 1, b = 1, c = 2; // f(0), f(1), f(2)
        for (int i = 3; i <= n; i++) { long d = (2 * c + a) % MOD; a = b; b = c; c = d; }
        return (int) c;
    }

    // ---------- Count Different Palindromic Subsequences (LC 730): interval DP, shrink to the outermost equal characters ----------
    static int countPalindromicSubsequences(String s) {
        final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
        int n = s.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dp[i][i] = 1;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++)
            for (int i = 0; i + len - 1 < n; i++) {
                int j = i + len - 1;
                if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(j)) {
                    dp[i][j] = ((dp[i + 1][j] + dp[i][j - 1] - dp[i + 1][j - 1]) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
                } else {
                    int lo = i + 1, hi = j - 1;
                    while (lo <= hi && s.charAt(lo) != s.charAt(i)) lo++;
                    while (lo <= hi && s.charAt(hi) != s.charAt(i)) hi--;
                    long inner = dp[i + 1][j - 1];
                    if (lo > hi) dp[i][j] = (int) ((2 * inner + 2) % MOD);          // no same char inside: a, aa, plus wrapped
                    else if (lo == hi) dp[i][j] = (int) ((2 * inner + 1) % MOD);    // exactly one inside: "a" is already counted
                    else dp[i][j] = (int) (((2 * inner - dp[lo + 1][hi - 1]) % MOD + MOD) % MOD); // remove double count
                }
            }
        return dp[0][n - 1];
    }

    // ---------- Profitable Schemes (LC 879): dp[people used][profit capped at minProfit]; capping keeps the table small ----------
    static int profitableSchemes(int n, int minProfit, int[] group, int[] profit) {
        final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][minProfit + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int k = 0; k < group.length; k++) {
            int[][] next = new int[n + 1][minProfit + 1];
            for (int people = 0; people <= n; people++)
                for (int p = 0; p <= minProfit; p++) {
                    if (dp[people][p] == 0) continue;
                    next[people][p] = (next[people][p] + dp[people][p]) % MOD;           // skip this crime
                    if (people + group[k] <= n) {
                        int np = Math.min(minProfit, p + profit[k]);                       // profit above the cap collapses into the cap
                        next[people + group[k]][np] = (next[people + group[k]][np] + dp[people][p]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            dp = next;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int people = 0; people <= n; people++) total = (total + dp[people][minProfit]) % MOD;
        return total;
    }

    // ---------- Tallest Billboard (LC 956): dp[difference between the two towers] = tallest shorter tower ----------
    static int tallestBillboard(int[] rods) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> dp = new HashMap<>();
        dp.put(0, 0);
        for (int r : rods) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> next = new HashMap<>(dp);
            for (var e : dp.entrySet()) {
                int diff = e.getKey(), shorter = e.getValue();
                next.merge(diff + r, shorter, Math::max);                              // add to the taller tower
                next.merge(Math.abs(diff - r), shorter + Math.min(diff, r), Math::max); // add to the shorter tower
            }
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp.get(0);
    }

    // ---------- Best Team With No Conflicts (LC 1626): sort by (age, score), LIS on score allowing equal ----------
    static int bestTeamScore(int[] scores, int[] ages) {
        int n = scores.length;
        Integer[] idx = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(idx, (a, b) -> ages[a] != ages[b] ? ages[a] - ages[b] : scores[a] - scores[b]);
        int[] dp = new int[n];
        int best = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            dp[i] = scores[idx[i]];
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (scores[idx[j]] <= scores[idx[i]]) dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], dp[j] + scores[idx[i]]);
            best = Math.max(best, dp[i]);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Remove Boxes (LC 546): dp[l][r][k] with k equal boxes attached to the left of l ----------
    static int removeBoxes(int[] boxes) {
        int n = boxes.length;
        return rb(boxes, 0, n - 1, 0, new int[n][n][n]);
    }

    // … rb(): helper hidden
    private static int rb(int[] b, int l, int r, int k, int[][][] memo) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        if (memo[l][r][k] != 0) return memo[l][r][k];
        while (l < r && b[l + 1] == b[l]) { l++; k++; } // absorb equal neighbours into k
        int best = (k + 1) * (k + 1) + rb(b, l + 1, r, 0, memo); // remove b[l] with its k friends now
        for (int m = l + 1; m <= r; m++)
            if (b[m] == b[l]) best = Math.max(best, rb(b, l + 1, m - 1, 0, memo) + rb(b, m, r, k + 1, memo)); // clear the middle first, then merge
        return memo[l][r][k] = best;
    }

    // ---------- Minimum Cost to Merge Stones (LC 1000): dp[i][j][m] = min cost to turn stones i..j into m piles ----------
    static int mergeStones(int[] stones, int k) {
        int n = stones.length;
        if ((n - 1) % (k - 1) != 0) return -1;
        int[] prefix = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + stones[i];
        int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        int[][][] dp = new int[n][n][k + 1];
        for (int[][] a : dp) for (int[] b : a) Arrays.fill(b, INF);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dp[i][i][1] = 0;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++)
            for (int i = 0; i + len - 1 < n; i++) {
                int j = i + len - 1;
                for (int m = 2; m <= k; m++)
                    for (int mid = i; mid < j; mid += k - 1)
                        dp[i][j][m] = Math.min(dp[i][j][m], dp[i][mid][1] + dp[mid + 1][j][m - 1]);
                dp[i][j][1] = Math.min(dp[i][j][1], dp[i][j][k] + prefix[j + 1] - prefix[i]);
            }
        return dp[0][n - 1][1];
    }

    // ---------- Minimum Cost Tree From Leaf Values (LC 1130): interval DP, or the greedy monotone stack ----------
    static int mctFromLeafValues(int[] arr) {
        Deque<Integer> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        st.push(Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        int cost = 0;
        for (int x : arr) {
            while (st.peek() <= x) { int mid = st.pop(); cost += mid * Math.min(st.peek(), x); } // smallest leaf merges with its smaller neighbour
            st.push(x);
        }
        while (st.size() > 2) cost += st.pop() * st.peek();
        return cost;
    }

    // ---------- Shortest Common Supersequence (LC 1092): LCS table, then walk back merging ----------
    static String shortestCommonSupersequence(String a, String b) {
        int n = a.length(), m = b.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
                dp[i][j] = a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1) ? dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1 : Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int i = n, j = m;
        while (i > 0 && j > 0) {
            if (a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1)) { sb.append(a.charAt(i - 1)); i--; j--; }
            else if (dp[i - 1][j] >= dp[i][j - 1]) sb.append(a.charAt(--i));
            else sb.append(b.charAt(--j));
        }
        while (i > 0) sb.append(a.charAt(--i));
        while (j > 0) sb.append(b.charAt(--j));
        return sb.reverse().toString();
    }

    // ---------- Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome (LC 1312): n - LPS ----------
    static int minInsertions(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++)
            for (int i = 0; i + len - 1 < n; i++) {
                int j = i + len - 1;
                dp[i][j] = s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j) ? dp[i + 1][j - 1] : 1 + Math.min(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        return dp[0][n - 1];
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Sum of 3 Non-Overlapping Subarrays (LC 689): best-left, best-right, try every middle ----------
    static int[] maxSumOfThreeSubarrays(int[] a, int k) {
        int n = a.length, m = n - k + 1;
        int[] w = new int[m];
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { sum += a[i]; if (i >= k) sum -= a[i - k]; if (i >= k - 1) w[i - k + 1] = sum; }
        int[] left = new int[m], right = new int[m];
        int best = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { if (w[i] > w[best]) best = i; left[i] = best; }
        best = m - 1;
        for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (w[i] >= w[best]) best = i; right[i] = best; } // >= keeps the lexicographically smallest index
        int[] res = {-1, -1, -1};
        int top = -1;
        for (int mid = k; mid < m - k; mid++) {
            int l = left[mid - k], r = right[mid + k], total = w[l] + w[mid] + w[r];
            if (total > top) { top = total; res = new int[]{l, mid, r}; }
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Delete and Earn (LC 740): bucket by value, then House Robber on the buckets ----------
    static int deleteAndEarn(int[] nums) {
        int max = 0;
        for (int x : nums) max = Math.max(max, x);
        int[] gain = new int[max + 1];
        for (int x : nums) gain[x] += x;
        int take = 0, skip = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v <= max; v++) { int nt = skip + gain[v], ns = Math.max(skip, take); take = nt; skip = ns; }
        return Math.max(take, skip);
    }

    // ---------- Integer Break (LC 343) ----------
    static int integerBreak(int n) {
        int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
        dp[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], Math.max(j * (i - j), j * dp[i - j]));
        return dp[n];
    }

    // ---------- Largest Divisible Subset (LC 368): sort, LIS with the divisibility relation, rebuild by parent ----------
    static List<Integer> largestDivisibleSubset(int[] a) {
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int n = a.length, bestEnd = 0;
        int[] len = new int[n], parent = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(len, 1);
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (a[i] % a[j] == 0 && len[j] + 1 > len[i]) { len[i] = len[j] + 1; parent[i] = j; }
            if (len[i] > len[bestEnd]) bestEnd = i;
        }
        LinkedList<Integer> res = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = bestEnd; i != -1; i = parent[i]) res.addFirst(a[i]);
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Longest String Chain (LC 1048): process words by length, delete one char to find predecessors ----------
    static int longestStrChain(String[] words) {
        Arrays.sort(words, Comparator.comparingInt(String::length));
        Map<String, Integer> best = new HashMap<>();
        int res = 1;
        for (String w : words) {
            int cur = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < w.length(); i++) {
                Integer prev = best.get(w.substring(0, i) + w.substring(i + 1));
                if (prev != null) cur = Math.max(cur, prev + 1);
            }
            best.put(w, cur);
            res = Math.max(res, cur);
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Count Vowels Permutation (LC 1220) ----------
    static int countVowelPermutation(int n) {
        final long MOD = 1_000_000_007L;
        long a = 1, e = 1, i = 1, o = 1, u = 1;
        for (int step = 1; step < n; step++) {
            long na = (e + i + u) % MOD, ne = (a + i) % MOD, ni = (e + o) % MOD, no = i % MOD, nu = (i + o) % MOD;
            a = na; e = ne; i = ni; o = no; u = nu;
        }
        return (int) ((a + e + i + o + u) % MOD);
    }

    // ---------- Student Attendance Record II (LC 552): state = (absences 0..1, trailing lates 0..2) ----------
    static int checkRecord(int n) {
        final long MOD = 1_000_000_007L;
        long[][] dp = new long[2][3];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int day = 0; day < n; day++) {
            long[][] next = new long[2][3];
            for (int a = 0; a < 2; a++)
                for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++) {
                    long v = dp[a][l];
                    if (v == 0) continue;
                    next[a][0] = (next[a][0] + v) % MOD;                     // present
                    if (a == 0) next[1][0] = (next[1][0] + v) % MOD;         // absent
                    if (l < 2) next[a][l + 1] = (next[a][l + 1] + v) % MOD;  // late
                }
            dp = next;
        }
        long total = 0;
        for (long[] row : dp) for (long v : row) total = (total + v) % MOD;
        return (int) total;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. State the dimension you added and what it stands for before writing the recurrence.
  2. Interval DP with an extra state: memoize with the extra dimension, not just (l, r).
  3. Reconstruction: keep a parent pointer or walk the table backwards, never recompute.

23 — BINARYTREE.JAVA

Binary Tree Patterns

Most tree problems are one post-order that returns a value and optionally updates a global. Traversals, level order, LCA, build from traversals, serialization and tree dp share that skeleton.

PatternUse caseComplexity
TraversalsInorder / preorder / postorder iterative, Morris for O(1) spaceO(n)
Level orderQueue with a level-size snapshotO(n)
Post-order value + globalHeight, diameter, max path sum, balancedO(n)
Tree dpRob III, cameras: return a small state tuple per nodeO(n)
BinaryTree.java
Traversals, level order, diameter, max path sum, LCA, build, serialize, flatten, distance K, vertical order, rob III, cameras
O(n)
  • any "visit every node" ask. Recursive is fine; know the iterative forms for follow-ups. inorder
  • Answer per level? → BFS with a level-size snapshot levelOrder
  • Visit every node with a value flowing up? → One post-order returning a value (and a global for the answer) diameter
  • Best path that may bend at a node? → Return best downward gain, update global with the bent path maxPathSum
  • Count paths with a given sum? → Prefix-sum map along the root path, backtrack pathSumIII
  • Lowest common ancestor? → Post-order: both sides non-null means this node lowestCommonAncestor
    • 2 more
  • Rebuild or store a tree? → Preorder + inorder map, or preorder with null markers serialize
  • Choose nodes with no two adjacent (tree dp)? → Return {take, skip} per node robTree
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class BinaryTree {

    static class TreeNode {
        int val;
        TreeNode left, right;
        TreeNode(int v) { val = v; }
    }

    // ---------- Traversals ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: any "visit every node" ask. Recursive is fine; know the iterative forms for follow-ups.
    static List<Integer> inorder(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        Deque<TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        TreeNode cur = root;
        while (cur != null || !st.isEmpty()) {
            while (cur != null) { st.push(cur); cur = cur.left; }
            cur = st.pop();
            out.add(cur.val);
            cur = cur.right;
        }
        return out;
    }

    static List<Integer> preorder(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        Deque<TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        if (root != null) st.push(root);
        while (!st.isEmpty()) {
            TreeNode n = st.pop();
            out.add(n.val);
            if (n.right != null) st.push(n.right);
            if (n.left != null) st.push(n.left);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // postorder = reverse of (root, right, left)
    static List<Integer> postorder(TreeNode root) {
        LinkedList<Integer> out = new LinkedList<>();
        Deque<TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        if (root != null) st.push(root);
        while (!st.isEmpty()) {
            TreeNode n = st.pop();
            out.addFirst(n.val);
            if (n.left != null) st.push(n.left);
            if (n.right != null) st.push(n.right);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // Morris inorder: O(1) extra space by threading predecessor.right -> current
    static List<Integer> inorderMorris(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        TreeNode cur = root;
        while (cur != null) {
            if (cur.left == null) { out.add(cur.val); cur = cur.right; continue; }
            TreeNode pred = cur.left;
            while (pred.right != null && pred.right != cur) pred = pred.right;
            if (pred.right == null) { pred.right = cur; cur = cur.left; }
            else { pred.right = null; out.add(cur.val); cur = cur.right; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // Level order (LC 102): one queue, snapshot the level size
    static List<List<Integer>> levelOrder(TreeNode root) {
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (root == null) return res;
        Deque<TreeNode> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(root);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q.size();
            List<Integer> level = new ArrayList<>();
            while (sz-- > 0) {
                TreeNode n = q.poll();
                level.add(n.val);
                if (n.left != null) q.add(n.left);
                if (n.right != null) q.add(n.right);
            }
            res.add(level);
        }
        return res;
    }

    // Zigzag (LC 103)
    static List<List<Integer>> zigzag(TreeNode root) {
        List<List<Integer>> res = levelOrder(root);
        for (int i = 1; i < res.size(); i += 2) Collections.reverse(res.get(i));
        return res;
    }

    // Right side view (LC 199): last node of each level
    static List<Integer> rightSideView(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Integer> lv : levelOrder(root)) out.add(lv.get(lv.size() - 1));
        return out;
    }

    // ---------- Height / balance / diameter: ONE post-order returning a value, updating a global ----------
    static int maxDepth(TreeNode n) { return n == null ? 0 : 1 + Math.max(maxDepth(n.left), maxDepth(n.right)); }

    private static int diam;

    static int diameter(TreeNode root) {
        diam = 0;
        depthForDiameter(root);
        return diam; // in edges
    }

    // … depthForDiameter(): helper hidden
    private static int depthForDiameter(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int l = depthForDiameter(n.left), r = depthForDiameter(n.right);
        diam = Math.max(diam, l + r);
        return 1 + Math.max(l, r);
    }

    // Balanced (LC 110): -1 means "unbalanced" bubbled up
    static boolean isBalanced(TreeNode root) { return height(root) >= 0; }

    // … height(): helper hidden
    private static int height(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int l = height(n.left);
        if (l < 0) return -1;
        int r = height(n.right);
        if (r < 0 || Math.abs(l - r) > 1) return -1;
        return 1 + Math.max(l, r);
    }

    // Max path sum (LC 124): return the best DOWNWARD gain, update answer with the bent path through node
    private static int bestPath;

    static int maxPathSum(TreeNode root) {
        bestPath = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        gain(root);
        return bestPath;
    }

    // … gain(): helper hidden
    private static int gain(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int l = Math.max(0, gain(n.left)), r = Math.max(0, gain(n.right));
        bestPath = Math.max(bestPath, n.val + l + r);
        return n.val + Math.max(l, r);
    }

    // ---------- Structure checks ----------
    static boolean isSameTree(TreeNode a, TreeNode b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) return a == b;
        return a.val == b.val && isSameTree(a.left, b.left) && isSameTree(a.right, b.right);
    }

    static boolean isSymmetric(TreeNode root) { return root == null || mirror(root.left, root.right); }

    // … mirror(): helper hidden
    private static boolean mirror(TreeNode a, TreeNode b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) return a == b;
        return a.val == b.val && mirror(a.left, b.right) && mirror(a.right, b.left);
    }

    static TreeNode invertTree(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return null;
        TreeNode t = n.left;
        n.left = invertTree(n.right);
        n.right = invertTree(t);
        return n;
    }

    // Subtree of another tree (LC 572)
    static boolean isSubtree(TreeNode root, TreeNode sub) {
        if (root == null) return sub == null;
        return isSameTree(root, sub) || isSubtree(root.left, sub) || isSubtree(root.right, sub);
    }

    // ---------- Path sums ----------
    static boolean hasPathSum(TreeNode n, int target) {
        if (n == null) return false;
        if (n.left == null && n.right == null) return n.val == target;
        return hasPathSum(n.left, target - n.val) || hasPathSum(n.right, target - n.val);
    }

    // Path Sum III (LC 437): prefix-sum map along the root-to-node path
    static int pathSumIII(TreeNode root, int target) {
        Map<Long, Integer> seen = new HashMap<>();
        seen.put(0L, 1);
        return pathSumDfs(root, 0, target, seen);
    }

    // … pathSumDfs(): helper hidden
    private static int pathSumDfs(TreeNode n, long sum, int target, Map<Long, Integer> seen) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        sum += n.val;
        int count = seen.getOrDefault(sum - target, 0);
        seen.merge(sum, 1, Integer::sum);
        count += pathSumDfs(n.left, sum, target, seen) + pathSumDfs(n.right, sum, target, seen);
        seen.merge(sum, -1, Integer::sum); // backtrack
        return count;
    }

    // ---------- LCA (binary tree) (LC 236) ----------
    static TreeNode lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
        if (root == null || root == p || root == q) return root;
        TreeNode l = lowestCommonAncestor(root.left, p, q), r = lowestCommonAncestor(root.right, p, q);
        return l != null && r != null ? root : l != null ? l : r;
    }

    // ---------- Build from traversals ----------
    // Preorder + inorder (LC 105)
    static TreeNode buildTree(int[] pre, int[] in) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> pos = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < in.length; i++) pos.put(in[i], i);
        return build(pre, new int[]{0}, 0, in.length - 1, pos);
    }

    // … build(): helper hidden
    private static TreeNode build(int[] pre, int[] pi, int lo, int hi, Map<Integer, Integer> pos) {
        if (lo > hi) return null;
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(pre[pi[0]++]);
        int mid = pos.get(root.val);
        root.left = build(pre, pi, lo, mid - 1, pos);
        root.right = build(pre, pi, mid + 1, hi, pos);
        return root;
    }

    // ---------- Serialize / deserialize (LC 297): preorder with null markers ----------
    static String serialize(TreeNode root) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        ser(root, sb);
        return sb.toString();
    }

    // … ser(): helper hidden
    private static void ser(TreeNode n, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (n == null) { sb.append("#,"); return; }
        sb.append(n.val).append(',');
        ser(n.left, sb);
        ser(n.right, sb);
    }

    static TreeNode deserialize(String data) {
        return des(new ArrayDeque<>(Arrays.asList(data.split(","))));
    }

    // … des(): helper hidden
    private static TreeNode des(Deque<String> q) {
        String s = q.poll();
        if (s == null || s.equals("#")) return null;
        TreeNode n = new TreeNode(Integer.parseInt(s));
        n.left = des(q);
        n.right = des(q);
        return n;
    }

    // ---------- Flatten to linked list (LC 114) ----------
    static void flatten(TreeNode root) {
        TreeNode cur = root;
        while (cur != null) {
            if (cur.left != null) {
                TreeNode p = cur.left;
                while (p.right != null) p = p.right;
                p.right = cur.right;
                cur.right = cur.left;
                cur.left = null;
            }
            cur = cur.right;
        }
    }

    // ---------- Distance K from a node (LC 863): parent map + BFS ----------
    static List<Integer> distanceK(TreeNode root, TreeNode target, int k) {
        Map<TreeNode, TreeNode> parent = new HashMap<>();
        Deque<TreeNode> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(root);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            TreeNode n = q.poll();
            for (TreeNode c : new TreeNode[]{n.left, n.right})
                if (c != null) { parent.put(c, n); q.add(c); }
        }
        Set<TreeNode> seen = new HashSet<>(List.of(target));
        q.add(target);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && k-- > 0) {
            for (int s = q.size(); s > 0; s--) {
                TreeNode n = q.poll();
                for (TreeNode nb : new TreeNode[]{n.left, n.right, parent.get(n)})
                    if (nb != null && seen.add(nb)) q.add(nb);
            }
        }
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (TreeNode n : q) out.add(n.val);
        return out;
    }

    // ---------- Vertical order (LC 987): sort by column, then row, then value ----------
    static List<List<Integer>> verticalTraversal(TreeNode root) {
        List<int[]> cells = new ArrayList<>(); // col, row, val
        Deque<Object[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new Object[]{root, 0, 0});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Object[] t = q.poll();
            TreeNode n = (TreeNode) t[0];
            if (n == null) continue;
            int col = (int) t[1], row = (int) t[2];
            cells.add(new int[]{col, row, n.val});
            q.add(new Object[]{n.left, col - 1, row + 1});
            q.add(new Object[]{n.right, col + 1, row + 1});
        }
        cells.sort((a, b) -> a[0] != b[0] ? a[0] - b[0] : a[1] != b[1] ? a[1] - b[1] : a[2] - b[2]);
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        int prev = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        for (int[] c : cells) {
            if (c[0] != prev) { res.add(new ArrayList<>()); prev = c[0]; }
            res.get(res.size() - 1).add(c[2]);
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Tree DP: House Robber III (LC 337) -> {rob this, skip this} ----------
    static int robTree(TreeNode root) {
        int[] r = robDfs(root);
        return Math.max(r[0], r[1]);
    }

    // … robDfs(): helper hidden
    private static int[] robDfs(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return new int[]{0, 0};
        int[] l = robDfs(n.left), r = robDfs(n.right);
        return new int[]{n.val + l[1] + r[1], Math.max(l[0], l[1]) + Math.max(r[0], r[1])};
    }

    // Binary Tree Cameras (LC 968): states 0 = needs cover, 1 = has camera, 2 = covered
    private static int cams;

    static int minCameraCover(TreeNode root) {
        cams = 0;
        return (cover(root) == 0 ? 1 : 0) + cams;
    }

    // … cover(): helper hidden
    private static int cover(TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 2;
        int l = cover(n.left), r = cover(n.right);
        if (l == 0 || r == 0) { cams++; return 1; }
        return l == 1 || r == 1 ? 2 : 0;
    }

    // Helper for tests: build from level-order array, Integer null = absent
    static TreeNode fromLevel(Integer... a) {
        if (a.length == 0 || a[0] == null) return null;
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(a[0]);
        Deque<TreeNode> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(root);
        int i = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && i < a.length) {
            TreeNode n = q.poll();
            if (i < a.length && a[i] != null) { n.left = new TreeNode(a[i]); q.add(n.left); }
            i++;
            if (i < a.length && a[i] != null) { n.right = new TreeNode(a[i]); q.add(n.right); }
            i++;
        }
        return root;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Max path sum: return the best DOWNWARD gain (a path cannot fork upward), but update the answer with the bent path through the node.
  2. Path Sum III: backtrack the prefix-sum map after both children return.
  3. Recursion depth can hit 10^5 on a skewed tree; mention the iterative form.

Binary Search Trees

Inorder of a BST is sorted; every BST question is either "use that" or "carry open bounds down". Deletion with two children replaces the node with its inorder successor.

PatternUse caseComplexity
ValidateCarry (lo, hi) bounds, never compare only to the parentO(n)
Kth / iteratorIterative inorder, stop early; stack of the left spineO(h)
Search / LCAWalk down; no recursion neededO(h)
RecoverTwo inversions in the inorder sequenceO(n)
BST.java
Validate, search, insert, delete, kth smallest, LCA, sorted array to BST, recover, iterator, largest BST subtree, floor, Catalan count
O(h)
  • Validate or order-query a BST? → Carry bounds; use inorder = sorted isValidBST
  • Kth smallest in a BST, or lazy iteration? → Iterative inorder / stack of left spine kthSmallest
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class BST {
    // Uses BinaryTree.TreeNode (same package, default package).

    // ---------- Validate (LC 98): carry open bounds down ----------
    static boolean isValidBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) { return valid(n, null, null); }

    // … valid(): helper hidden
    private static boolean valid(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, Integer lo, Integer hi) {
        if (n == null) return true;
        if ((lo != null && n.val <= lo) || (hi != null && n.val >= hi)) return false;
        return valid(n.left, lo, n.val) && valid(n.right, n.val, hi);
    }

    // ---------- Search / insert / delete ----------
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode search(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int key) {
        while (n != null && n.val != key) n = key < n.val ? n.left : n.right;
        return n;
    }

    static BinaryTree.TreeNode insert(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int key) {
        if (n == null) return new BinaryTree.TreeNode(key);
        if (key < n.val) n.left = insert(n.left, key); else n.right = insert(n.right, key);
        return n;
    }

    // Delete (LC 450): 0 or 1 child -> splice; 2 children -> replace with inorder successor
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode delete(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int key) {
        if (n == null) return null;
        if (key < n.val) n.left = delete(n.left, key);
        else if (key > n.val) n.right = delete(n.right, key);
        else {
            if (n.left == null) return n.right;
            if (n.right == null) return n.left;
            BinaryTree.TreeNode s = n.right;
            while (s.left != null) s = s.left;
            n.val = s.val;
            n.right = delete(n.right, s.val);
        }
        return n;
    }

    // ---------- Kth smallest (LC 230): iterative inorder, stop early ----------
    static int kthSmallest(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int k) {
        Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        BinaryTree.TreeNode cur = root;
        while (cur != null || !st.isEmpty()) {
            while (cur != null) { st.push(cur); cur = cur.left; }
            cur = st.pop();
            if (--k == 0) return cur.val;
            cur = cur.right;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    // ---------- LCA in BST (LC 235): walk down, no recursion needed ----------
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode lcaBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int p, int q) {
        while (root != null) {
            if (p < root.val && q < root.val) root = root.left;
            else if (p > root.val && q > root.val) root = root.right;
            else return root;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ---------- Sorted array -> height-balanced BST (LC 108) ----------
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode sortedArrayToBST(int[] a) { return arr(a, 0, a.length - 1); }

    // … arr(): helper hidden
    private static BinaryTree.TreeNode arr(int[] a, int lo, int hi) {
        if (lo > hi) return null;
        int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
        BinaryTree.TreeNode n = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(a[mid]);
        n.left = arr(a, lo, mid - 1);
        n.right = arr(a, mid + 1, hi);
        return n;
    }

    // ---------- Recover BST (LC 99): two inversions in the inorder sequence ----------
    static void recoverTree(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        BinaryTree.TreeNode first = null, second = null, prev = null, cur = root;
        Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        while (cur != null || !st.isEmpty()) {
            while (cur != null) { st.push(cur); cur = cur.left; }
            cur = st.pop();
            if (prev != null && prev.val > cur.val) {
                if (first == null) first = prev;
                second = cur;
            }
            prev = cur;
            cur = cur.right;
        }
        int t = first.val; first.val = second.val; second.val = t;
    }

    // ---------- BST Iterator (LC 173): stack of left spine, O(h) space, amortized O(1) next ----------
    static class BSTIterator {
        private final Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        BSTIterator(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { push(root); }
        private void push(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) { while (n != null) { st.push(n); n = n.left; } }
        int next() { BinaryTree.TreeNode n = st.pop(); push(n.right); return n.val; }
        boolean hasNext() { return !st.isEmpty(); }
    }

    // ---------- Largest BST subtree (LC 333): post-order returns {isBST, size, min, max} ----------
    static int largestBSTSubtree(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { return lb(root)[3]; }

    // … lb(): helper hidden
    // returns {min, max, isBST(1/0), bestSize / size}
    private static int[] lb(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE, 1, 0};
        int[] l = lb(n.left), r = lb(n.right);
        if (l[2] == 1 && r[2] == 1 && l[1] < n.val && n.val < r[0]) {
            int size = l[3] + r[3] + 1;
            return new int[]{Math.min(l[0], n.val), Math.max(r[1], n.val), 1, size};
        }
        return new int[]{0, 0, 0, Math.max(l[3], r[3])};
    }

    // ---------- Floor / ceiling ----------
    static Integer floor(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int x) {
        Integer best = null;
        while (n != null) {
            if (n.val == x) return x;
            if (n.val < x) { best = n.val; n = n.right; } else n = n.left;
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Unique BSTs count (LC 96): Catalan ----------
    static int numTrees(int n) {
        int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
        dp[0] = dp[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) dp[i] += dp[j] * dp[i - 1 - j];
        return dp[n];
    }

    // TreeMap cheat sheet (when an ordered structure is needed in an interview):
    //   floorKey / ceilingKey / lowerKey / higherKey / firstKey / lastKey / pollFirstEntry / headMap / tailMap -- all O(log n)
}

Pitfalls

  1. Comparing a node only against its parent accepts invalid trees; carry bounds.
  2. Recover BST: the first inversion marks first = prev, the last marks second = cur.
  3. TreeMap gives floor/ceiling/first/last in O(log n) when a whole ordered structure is needed.

Tries

Use a trie when many queries share prefixes: autocomplete, dictionary with wildcards, word search over a grid, and bitwise tries for maximum XOR.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Insert / search / prefix26-way children with end marker and pass countO(L)
WildcardDFS over children on a dotO(26^L) worst
Grid + triePrune words as they are foundO(cells * 4^L)
Binary trieMaximum XOR pair, greedy bit by bitO(32n)
Trie.java
Trie, wildcard search, word search II, maximum XOR, replace words, suggested products
O(L)
  • Prefix queries over many words? → Trie insert
  • Find words on a board? → Trie + grid DFS with pruning findWords
  • Maximum XOR of two numbers? → Binary trie, greedy opposite bit findMaximumXOR
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class Trie {

    // ---------- Basic trie (LC 208) ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: many prefix queries, autocomplete, dictionary + wildcard, word search over a grid.
    private final Trie[] next = new Trie[26];
    private boolean end;
    private int passCount; // how many inserted words pass through this node

    void insert(String w) {
        Trie t = this;
        for (char c : w.toCharArray()) {
            if (t.next[c - 'a'] == null) t.next[c - 'a'] = new Trie();
            t = t.next[c - 'a'];
            t.passCount++;
        }
        t.end = true;
    }

    // … walk(): helper hidden
    private Trie walk(String s) {
        Trie t = this;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            t = t.next[c - 'a'];
            if (t == null) return null;
        }
        return t;
    }

    boolean search(String w) { Trie t = walk(w); return t != null && t.end; }
    boolean startsWith(String p) { return walk(p) != null; }
    int countPrefix(String p) { Trie t = walk(p); return t == null ? 0 : t.passCount; }

    // ---------- Wildcard '.' (LC 211): DFS over children on '.' ----------
    boolean searchWildcard(String w) { return wild(w, 0, this); }

    // … wild(): helper hidden
    private boolean wild(String w, int i, Trie t) {
        if (t == null) return false;
        if (i == w.length()) return t.end;
        char c = w.charAt(i);
        if (c != '.') return wild(w, i + 1, t.next[c - 'a']);
        for (Trie ch : t.next) if (ch != null && wild(w, i + 1, ch)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    // ---------- Word Search II (LC 212): trie + grid DFS, prune finished branches ----------
    static List<String> findWords(char[][] board, String[] words) {
        Node root = new Node();
        for (String w : words) {
            Node n = root;
            for (char c : w.toCharArray()) {
                if (n.kids[c - 'a'] == null) n.kids[c - 'a'] = new Node();
                n = n.kids[c - 'a'];
            }
            n.word = w;
        }
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) dfs(board, i, j, root, out);
        return out;
    }

    // … Node(): helper hidden
    private static class Node {
        Node[] kids = new Node[26];
        String word;
    }

    // … dfs(): helper hidden
    private static void dfs(char[][] b, int i, int j, Node p, List<String> out) {
        if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= b.length || j >= b[0].length) return;
        char c = b[i][j];
        if (c == '#' || p.kids[c - 'a'] == null) return;
        p = p.kids[c - 'a'];
        if (p.word != null) { out.add(p.word); p.word = null; } // dedupe
        b[i][j] = '#';
        dfs(b, i + 1, j, p, out); dfs(b, i - 1, j, p, out); dfs(b, i, j + 1, p, out); dfs(b, i, j - 1, p, out);
        b[i][j] = c;
    }

    // ---------- Binary trie: Maximum XOR of two numbers (LC 421) ----------
    static int findMaximumXOR(int[] nums) {
        int[][] ch = new int[nums.length * 32 + 2][2];
        int cnt = 1, best = 0;
        for (int x : nums) {
            int node = 0, other = 0, xr = 0;
            // insert x
            for (int b = 30; b >= 0; b--) {
                int bit = x >> b & 1;
                if (ch[node][bit] == 0) ch[node][bit] = cnt++;
                node = ch[node][bit];
            }
            // query best partner
            node = 0;
            for (int b = 30; b >= 0; b--) {
                int bit = x >> b & 1, want = bit ^ 1;
                if (ch[node][want] != 0) { xr |= 1 << b; node = ch[node][want]; } else node = ch[node][bit];
            }
            best = Math.max(best, xr);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Replace Words (LC 648): shortest root prefix ----------
    static String replaceWords(List<String> dict, String sentence) {
        Node root = new Node();
        for (String w : dict) {
            Node n = root;
            for (char c : w.toCharArray()) {
                if (n.kids[c - 'a'] == null) n.kids[c - 'a'] = new Node();
                n = n.kids[c - 'a'];
            }
            n.word = w;
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (String tok : sentence.split(" ")) {
            Node n = root;
            String rep = tok;
            for (char c : tok.toCharArray()) {
                n = n.kids[c - 'a'];
                if (n == null) break;
                if (n.word != null) { rep = n.word; break; }
            }
            if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append(rep);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    // ---------- Autocomplete top-3 (LC 1268 style): sorted words + binary search is the simple robust form ----------
    static List<List<String>> suggestedProducts(String[] products, String search) {
        Arrays.sort(products);
        List<List<String>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        String prefix = "";
        for (char c : search.toCharArray()) {
            prefix += c;
            int lo = 0, hi = products.length;
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
                if (products[mid].compareTo(prefix) < 0) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
            }
            List<String> top = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = lo; i < Math.min(lo + 3, products.length) && products[i].startsWith(prefix); i++) top.add(products[i]);
            res.add(top);
        }
        return res;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Word Search II: null out the stored word after finding it so duplicates are not reported.
  2. Binary trie over 31 bits (not 32) for non-negative ints keeps the sign bit out of the way.

Pick the lightest tool: prefix sums for static sums, a difference array for range add, Fenwick for point update plus prefix sum, a segment tree for any monoid, lazy propagation for range updates, a sparse table for static range min.

  • Point updates plus prefix sums, or counting inversions? → Fenwick tree countInversions
