// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class RangeStructures {

    // Pick: prefix sums (static), Fenwick (point update + prefix/range sum), segment tree (any monoid, range ops),
    //       lazy segment tree (range update), sparse table (static range min/max in O(1)).

    // ---------- Prefix sum / difference array ----------
    static long[] prefix(int[] a) {
        long[] p = new long[a.length + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) p[i + 1] = p[i] + a[i];
        return p; // sum [l, r] = p[r + 1] - p[l]
    }

    // Range add via difference array (LC 370 / 1109)
    static int[] rangeAdd(int n, int[][] updates) { // {l, r, v}
        int[] d = new int[n + 1];
        for (int[] u : updates) { d[u[0]] += u[2]; d[u[1] + 1] -= u[2]; }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        int run = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { run += d[i]; res[i] = run; }
        return res;
    }

    // 2D prefix sum (LC 304)
    static class NumMatrix {
        private final int[][] p;
        NumMatrix(int[][] m) {
            p = new int[m.length + 1][m[0].length + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < m.length; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m[0].length; j++) p[i + 1][j + 1] = m[i][j] + p[i][j + 1] + p[i + 1][j] - p[i][j];
        }
        int sumRegion(int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) { return p[r2 + 1][c2 + 1] - p[r1][c2 + 1] - p[r2 + 1][c1] + p[r1][c1]; }
    }

    // ---------- Fenwick tree (BIT), 1-indexed internally ----------
    static class Fenwick {
        private final long[] t;
        Fenwick(int n) { t = new long[n + 1]; }
        void add(int i, long delta) { for (i++; i < t.length; i += i & -i) t[i] += delta; }       // 0-indexed API
        long prefix(int i) { long s = 0; for (i++; i > 0; i -= i & -i) s += t[i]; return s; }     // sum [0, i]
        long range(int l, int r) { return prefix(r) - (l > 0 ? prefix(l - 1) : 0); }
    }

    // Count of Smaller Numbers After Self (LC 315): compress values, Fenwick over ranks, scan right to left
    static List<Integer> countSmaller(int[] nums) {
        int n = nums.length;
        int[] sorted = Arrays.stream(nums).distinct().sorted().toArray();
        Fenwick f = new Fenwick(sorted.length);
        Integer[] res = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int rank = Arrays.binarySearch(sorted, nums[i]);
            res[i] = rank == 0 ? 0 : (int) f.prefix(rank - 1);
            f.add(rank, 1);
        }
        return Arrays.asList(res);
    }

    // Count inversions with Fenwick
    static long countInversions(int[] a) {
        int[] sorted = Arrays.stream(a).distinct().sorted().toArray();
        Fenwick f = new Fenwick(sorted.length);
        long inv = 0;
        for (int i = a.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int rank = Arrays.binarySearch(sorted, a[i]);
            if (rank > 0) inv += f.prefix(rank - 1);
            f.add(rank, 1);
        }
        return inv;
    }

    // ---------- Segment tree (iterative, bottom-up): point update, range query (sum; swap combine for min/max) ----------
    static class SegTree {
        private final int n;
        private final long[] t;
        SegTree(int[] a) {
            n = a.length;
            t = new long[2 * n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) t[n + i] = a[i];
            for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) t[i] = t[2 * i] + t[2 * i + 1];
        }
        void set(int i, long v) {
            for (t[i += n] = v; i > 1; i >>= 1) t[i >> 1] = t[i] + t[i ^ 1];
        }
        long query(int l, int r) { // inclusive
            long res = 0;
            for (l += n, r += n + 1; l < r; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
                if ((l & 1) == 1) res += t[l++];
                if ((r & 1) == 1) res += t[--r];
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    // ---------- Lazy segment tree: range add + range sum (recursive) ----------
    static class LazySeg {
        private final long[] sum, lazy;
        private final int n;
        LazySeg(int[] a) {
            n = a.length;
            sum = new long[4 * n];
            lazy = new long[4 * n];
            build(1, 0, n - 1, a);
        }
        private void build(int o, int l, int r, int[] a) {
            if (l == r) { sum[o] = a[l]; return; }
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            build(2 * o, l, m, a);
            build(2 * o + 1, m + 1, r, a);
            sum[o] = sum[2 * o] + sum[2 * o + 1];
        }
        private void push(int o, int l, int r) {
            if (lazy[o] == 0) return;
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            apply(2 * o, l, m, lazy[o]);
            apply(2 * o + 1, m + 1, r, lazy[o]);
            lazy[o] = 0;
        }
        private void apply(int o, int l, int r, long v) { sum[o] += v * (r - l + 1); lazy[o] += v; }
        void add(int ql, int qr, long v) { add(1, 0, n - 1, ql, qr, v); }
        private void add(int o, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, long v) {
            if (qr < l || r < ql) return;
            if (ql <= l && r <= qr) { apply(o, l, r, v); return; }
            push(o, l, r);
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            add(2 * o, l, m, ql, qr, v);
            add(2 * o + 1, m + 1, r, ql, qr, v);
            sum[o] = sum[2 * o] + sum[2 * o + 1];
        }
        long query(int ql, int qr) { return query(1, 0, n - 1, ql, qr); }
        private long query(int o, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
            if (qr < l || r < ql) return 0;
            if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return sum[o];
            push(o, l, r);
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            return query(2 * o, l, m, ql, qr) + query(2 * o + 1, m + 1, r, ql, qr);
        }
    }

    // ---------- Sparse table: static range minimum in O(1) after O(n log n) build ----------
    static class SparseTable {
        private final int[][] st;
        private final int[] log;
        SparseTable(int[] a) {
            int n = a.length, K = 1;
            while ((1 << K) <= n) K++;
            st = new int[K][n];
            log = new int[n + 2];
            for (int i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) log[i] = log[i / 2] + 1;
            st[0] = a.clone();
            for (int k = 1; k < K; k++)
                for (int i = 0; i + (1 << k) <= n; i++) st[k][i] = Math.min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + (1 << (k - 1))]);
        }
        int min(int l, int r) {
            int k = log[r - l + 1];
            return Math.min(st[k][l], st[k][r - (1 << k) + 1]);
        }
    }

    // ---------- Skyline (LC 218): sweep + max-heap with lazy deletion ----------
    static List<List<Integer>> getSkyline(int[][] b) {
        List<int[]> ev = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int[] x : b) { ev.add(new int[]{x[0], -x[2]}); ev.add(new int[]{x[1], x[2]}); }
        ev.sort((p, q) -> p[0] != q[0] ? p[0] - q[0] : p[1] - q[1]); // starts (negative) before ends at equal x, taller start first
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> heights = new TreeMap<>();
        heights.put(0, 1);
        int prev = 0;
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int[] e : ev) {
            if (e[1] < 0) heights.merge(-e[1], 1, Integer::sum);
            else heights.merge(e[1], -1, (a, c) -> a + c == 0 ? null : a + c);
            int cur = heights.lastKey();
            if (cur != prev) { res.add(List.of(e[0], cur)); prev = cur; }
        }
        return res;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Fenwick is 1-indexed internally; the template exposes a 0-indexed API.
  2. Count-smaller problems: compress values to ranks first, then scan right to left.
  3. Skyline: process starts before ends at equal x and keep a TreeMap multiset of heights.

Two shapes cover most hard tree problems: post-order returns one value to the parent while a global tracks the answer, or pre-order carries state down. The rest is construction, enumeration and BST bounds.

Hard variants

  • Width of a level? → Heap indices, subtract the level's first widthOfBinaryTree

  • Rebuild from inorder + postorder? → Consume postorder from the end, right first buildTreeInPost
  • Spread outward from a start node? → One DFS returning depth or negative distance amountOfTime

// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class TreesVariants {
    // Uses BinaryTree.TreeNode; build test trees with BinaryTree.fromLevel(...).
    // Two shapes cover most of these: (1) post-order returns one value to the parent while a global tracks the answer,
    // (2) pre-order carries state down (a path sum, a bound, a depth) as parameters.

    // ---------- Boundary of Binary Tree (LC 545): left edge + leaves + right edge reversed ----------
    static List<Integer> boundaryOfBinaryTree(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (root == null) return res;
        if (!isLeaf(root)) res.add(root.val);
        BinaryTree.TreeNode n = root.left;
        while (n != null) { if (!isLeaf(n)) res.add(n.val); n = n.left != null ? n.left : n.right; }
        leaves(root, res);
        Deque<Integer> right = new ArrayDeque<>();
        n = root.right;
        while (n != null) { if (!isLeaf(n)) right.push(n.val); n = n.right != null ? n.right : n.left; }
        res.addAll(right);
        return res;
    }

    // … isLeaf(): helper hidden
    private static boolean isLeaf(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) { return n.left == null && n.right == null; }

    // … leaves(): helper hidden
    private static void leaves(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, List<Integer> out) {
        if (n == null) return;
        if (isLeaf(n)) { out.add(n.val); return; }
        leaves(n.left, out);
        leaves(n.right, out);
    }

    // ---------- Distribute Coins in Binary Tree (LC 979): each edge carries |excess of its subtree| moves ----------
    private static int moves;

    static int distributeCoins(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { moves = 0; excess(root); return moves; }

    // … excess(): helper hidden
    private static int excess(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int e = n.val - 1 + excess(n.left) + excess(n.right);
        moves += Math.abs(e);
        return e;
    }

    // ---------- Longest Univalue Path (LC 687): post-order returns the longest downward same-value arm ----------
    private static int uniBest;

    static int longestUnivaluePath(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { uniBest = 0; arm(root); return uniBest; }

    // … arm(): helper hidden
    private static int arm(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int l = arm(n.left), r = arm(n.right);
        int al = n.left != null && n.left.val == n.val ? l + 1 : 0;
        int ar = n.right != null && n.right.val == n.val ? r + 1 : 0;
        uniBest = Math.max(uniBest, al + ar);
        return Math.max(al, ar);
    }

    // ---------- Sum Root to Leaf Numbers (LC 129): pass the number down ----------
    static int sumNumbers(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { return sumDown(root, 0); }

    // … sumDown(): helper hidden
    private static int sumDown(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int acc) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        acc = acc * 10 + n.val;
        return isLeaf(n) ? acc : sumDown(n.left, acc) + sumDown(n.right, acc);
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Width of Binary Tree (LC 662): heap-style indices; subtract the level's first index to avoid overflow ----------
    static int widthOfBinaryTree(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return 0;
        Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Deque<Long> idx = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(root);
        idx.add(0L);
        long best = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            long first = idx.peekFirst(), last = first;
            for (int size = q.size(); size > 0; size--) {
                BinaryTree.TreeNode n = q.poll();
                long i = idx.poll() - first;
                last = i;
                if (n.left != null) { q.add(n.left); idx.add(2 * i); }
                if (n.right != null) { q.add(n.right); idx.add(2 * i + 1); }
            }
            best = Math.max(best, last + 1);
        }
        return (int) best;
    }

    // ---------- Find Duplicate Subtrees (LC 652): canonical serialization -> id; report an id the second time it is seen ----------
    static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> findDuplicateSubtrees(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> res = new ArrayList<>();
        dupId(root, new HashMap<>(), new HashMap<>(), res);
        return res;
    }

    // … dupId(): helper hidden
    private static int dupId(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, Map<String, Integer> ids, Map<Integer, Integer> counts, List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> res) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        String key = dupId(n.left, ids, counts, res) + "," + n.val + "," + dupId(n.right, ids, counts, res);
        int id = ids.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> ids.size() + 1);
        if (counts.merge(id, 1, Integer::sum) == 2) res.add(n);
        return id;
    }

    // ---------- All Possible Full Binary Trees (LC 894): memoized by node count ----------
    static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> allPossibleFBT(int n) { return fbt(n, new HashMap<>()); }

    // … fbt(): helper hidden
    private static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> fbt(int n, Map<Integer, List<BinaryTree.TreeNode>> memo) {
        if (n % 2 == 0) return List.of();
        if (n == 1) return List.of(new BinaryTree.TreeNode(0));
        if (memo.containsKey(n)) return memo.get(n);
        List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int left = 1; left < n; left += 2)
            for (BinaryTree.TreeNode l : fbt(left, memo))
                for (BinaryTree.TreeNode r : fbt(n - 1 - left, memo)) { // subtrees may be shared: trees are only read afterwards
                    BinaryTree.TreeNode root = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(0);
                    root.left = l;
                    root.right = r;
                    res.add(root);
                }
        memo.put(n, res);
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Unique Binary Search Trees II (LC 95): choose each root, combine every left x right ----------
    static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> generateTrees(int n) { return n == 0 ? List.of() : gen(1, n); }

    // … gen(): helper hidden
    private static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> gen(int lo, int hi) {
        List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (lo > hi) { res.add(null); return res; }
        for (int root = lo; root <= hi; root++)
            for (BinaryTree.TreeNode l : gen(lo, root - 1))
                for (BinaryTree.TreeNode r : gen(root + 1, hi)) {
                    BinaryTree.TreeNode t = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(root);
                    t.left = l;
                    t.right = r;
                    res.add(t);
                }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Construct from Inorder and Postorder (LC 106): postorder's last element is the root; build RIGHT first ----------
    private static int postIdx;

    static BinaryTree.TreeNode buildTreeInPost(int[] inorder, int[] postorder) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> pos = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < inorder.length; i++) pos.put(inorder[i], i);
        postIdx = postorder.length - 1;
        return buildPost(postorder, pos, 0, inorder.length - 1);
    }

    // … buildPost(): helper hidden
    private static BinaryTree.TreeNode buildPost(int[] post, Map<Integer, Integer> pos, int lo, int hi) {
        if (lo > hi) return null;
        BinaryTree.TreeNode root = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(post[postIdx--]);
        int mid = pos.get(root.val);
        root.right = buildPost(post, pos, mid + 1, hi); // right subtree comes just before the root in postorder
        root.left = buildPost(post, pos, lo, mid - 1);
        return root;
    }

    // ---------- Construct BST from Preorder (LC 1008): pass an upper bound, consume while values fit ----------
    private static int preIdx;

    static BinaryTree.TreeNode bstFromPreorder(int[] pre) { preIdx = 0; return bstBound(pre, Integer.MAX_VALUE); }

    // … bstBound(): helper hidden
    private static BinaryTree.TreeNode bstBound(int[] pre, int bound) {
        if (preIdx == pre.length || pre[preIdx] > bound) return null;
        BinaryTree.TreeNode root = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(pre[preIdx++]);
        root.left = bstBound(pre, root.val);
        root.right = bstBound(pre, bound);
        return root;
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Product of Splitted Binary Tree (LC 1339): total sum, then every subtree sum s gives s * (total - s) ----------
    static int maxProduct(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        List<Long> sums = new ArrayList<>();
        long total = subtreeSum(root, sums);
        long best = 0;
        for (long s : sums) best = Math.max(best, s * (total - s));
        return (int) (best % 1_000_000_007L);
    }

    // … subtreeSum(): helper hidden
    private static long subtreeSum(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, List<Long> sums) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        long s = n.val + subtreeSum(n.left, sums) + subtreeSum(n.right, sums);
        sums.add(s);
        return s;
    }

    // ---------- Amount of Time for Binary Tree to Be Infected (LC 2385): parent map + BFS, or one DFS returning depth / distance ----------
    private static int infected;

    static int amountOfTime(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int start) { infected = 0; infect(root, start); return infected; }

    // … infect(): helper hidden
    // returns depth of the subtree if `start` is not inside; otherwise a negative number -(distance from this node to start)
    private static int infect(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int start) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        int l = infect(n.left, start), r = infect(n.right, start);
        if (n.val == start) { infected = Math.max(l, r); return -1; }
        if (l >= 0 && r >= 0) return Math.max(l, r) + 1;
        int dist = Math.abs(l < 0 ? l : r);
        infected = Math.max(infected, dist + Math.max(l, r)); // other side's depth counts if non-negative
        return -(dist + 1);
    }

    // ---------- LCA of Deepest Leaves (LC 1123): return (depth, lca) pairs bottom-up ----------
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode lcaDeepestLeaves(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { return deepest(root).node; }

    // … Deep(): helper hidden
    private static class Deep { int depth; BinaryTree.TreeNode node; Deep(int d, BinaryTree.TreeNode n) { depth = d; node = n; } }

    // … deepest(): helper hidden
    private static Deep deepest(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return new Deep(0, null);
        Deep l = deepest(n.left), r = deepest(n.right);
        if (l.depth > r.depth) return new Deep(l.depth + 1, l.node);
        if (r.depth > l.depth) return new Deep(r.depth + 1, r.node);
        return new Deep(l.depth + 1, n);
    }

    // ---------- Delete Nodes And Return Forest (LC 1110): post-order, a deleted node promotes its children to roots ----------
    static List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> delNodes(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int[] toDelete) {
        Set<Integer> del = new HashSet<>();
        for (int d : toDelete) del.add(d);
        List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> forest = new ArrayList<>();
        if (prune(root, del, forest) != null) forest.add(root);
        return forest;
    }

    // … prune(): helper hidden
    private static BinaryTree.TreeNode prune(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, Set<Integer> del, List<BinaryTree.TreeNode> forest) {
        if (n == null) return null;
        n.left = prune(n.left, del, forest);
        n.right = prune(n.right, del, forest);
        if (!del.contains(n.val)) return n;
        if (n.left != null) forest.add(n.left);
        if (n.right != null) forest.add(n.right);
        return null;
    }

    // ---------- Count Complete Tree Nodes (LC 222): compare leftmost and rightmost depth; a perfect subtree is 2^h - 1 ----------
    static int countNodes(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return 0;
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        for (BinaryTree.TreeNode n = root; n != null; n = n.left) l++;
        for (BinaryTree.TreeNode n = root; n != null; n = n.right) r++;
        if (l == r) return (1 << l) - 1;
        return 1 + countNodes(root.left) + countNodes(root.right);
    }

    // ---------- Cousins in Binary Tree (LC 993): same depth, different parents ----------
    static boolean isCousins(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int x, int y) {
        Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(root);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            boolean fx = false, fy = false;
            for (int size = q.size(); size > 0; size--) {
                BinaryTree.TreeNode n = q.poll();
                if (n.left != null && n.right != null) {
                    int a = n.left.val, b = n.right.val;
                    if ((a == x && b == y) || (a == y && b == x)) return false; // siblings
                }
                for (BinaryTree.TreeNode c : new BinaryTree.TreeNode[]{n.left, n.right}) {
                    if (c == null) continue;
                    if (c.val == x) fx = true;
                    if (c.val == y) fy = true;
                    q.add(c);
                }
            }
            if (fx && fy) return true;
            if (fx || fy) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------- Binary Tree Paths (LC 257) and Path Sum II (LC 113): backtracking on a shared path list ----------
    static List<String> binaryTreePaths(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        List<String> res = new ArrayList<>();
        paths(root, new StringBuilder(), res);
        return res;
    }

    // … paths(): helper hidden
    private static void paths(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, StringBuilder cur, List<String> res) {
        if (n == null) return;
        int len = cur.length();
        cur.append(len == 0 ? "" : "->").append(n.val);
        if (isLeaf(n)) res.add(cur.toString());
        else { paths(n.left, cur, res); paths(n.right, cur, res); }
        cur.setLength(len);
    }

    static List<List<Integer>> pathSumII(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int target) {
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        pathSum(root, target, new ArrayList<>(), res);
        return res;
    }

    // … pathSum(): helper hidden
    private static void pathSum(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int remain, List<Integer> path, List<List<Integer>> res) {
        if (n == null) return;
        path.add(n.val);
        if (isLeaf(n) && remain == n.val) res.add(new ArrayList<>(path));
        pathSum(n.left, remain - n.val, path, res);
        pathSum(n.right, remain - n.val, path, res);
        path.remove(path.size() - 1);
    }

    // ---------- BST family: Convert BST to Greater Tree (LC 538) = reverse inorder with a running sum ----------
    private static int running;

    static BinaryTree.TreeNode convertBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) { running = 0; greater(root); return root; }

    // … greater(): helper hidden
    private static void greater(BinaryTree.TreeNode n) {
        if (n == null) return;
        greater(n.right);
        running += n.val;
        n.val = running;
        greater(n.left);
    }

    // Trim a BST (LC 669), Sorted Array to BST (LC 108), Minimum Difference in BST (LC 783), Range Sum of BST (LC 938)
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode trimBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int lo, int hi) {
        if (n == null) return null;
        if (n.val < lo) return trimBST(n.right, lo, hi);
        if (n.val > hi) return trimBST(n.left, lo, hi);
        n.left = trimBST(n.left, lo, hi);
        n.right = trimBST(n.right, lo, hi);
        return n;
    }

    static BinaryTree.TreeNode sortedArrayToBST(int[] a) { return sortedBuild(a, 0, a.length - 1); }

    // … sortedBuild(): helper hidden
    private static BinaryTree.TreeNode sortedBuild(int[] a, int lo, int hi) {
        if (lo > hi) return null;
        int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
        BinaryTree.TreeNode n = new BinaryTree.TreeNode(a[mid]);
        n.left = sortedBuild(a, lo, mid - 1);
        n.right = sortedBuild(a, mid + 1, hi);
        return n;
    }

    static int minDiffInBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode root) {
        int best = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Deque<BinaryTree.TreeNode> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        BinaryTree.TreeNode cur = root, prev = null;
        while (cur != null || !st.isEmpty()) {
            while (cur != null) { st.push(cur); cur = cur.left; }
            cur = st.pop();
            if (prev != null) best = Math.min(best, cur.val - prev.val);
            prev = cur;
            cur = cur.right;
        }
        return best;
    }

    static int rangeSumBST(BinaryTree.TreeNode n, int lo, int hi) {
        if (n == null) return 0;
        if (n.val < lo) return rangeSumBST(n.right, lo, hi);
        if (n.val > hi) return rangeSumBST(n.left, lo, hi);
        return n.val + rangeSumBST(n.left, lo, hi) + rangeSumBST(n.right, lo, hi);
    }

    // ---------- Inorder Successor in BST (LC 285): last ancestor where we went left ----------
    static BinaryTree.TreeNode inorderSuccessor(BinaryTree.TreeNode root, int p) {
        BinaryTree.TreeNode succ = null;
        while (root != null) {
            if (p < root.val) { succ = root; root = root.left; } else root = root.right;
        }
        return succ;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Width with heap indices overflows: subtract the level's first index.
  2. Building from postorder: take the root from the end and build the RIGHT subtree first.
  3. Shared subtrees in enumeration are fine if the trees are only read afterwards.

28 — ARRAYSHASHING.JAVA

Arrays & Hashing

The core move is turning a nested loop into one pass plus a map: store what you have seen (value, prefix sum, balance) and look up what you need. Most "count subarrays" problems are prefix sum + frequency map.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Complement mapTwo sum, pair conditionsO(n)
Prefix sum + mapSubarray sum = k, divisible by k, balanced 0/1O(n)
Index as hashFirst missing positive, find duplicateO(n)
In-place passesDutch flag, rotate, next permutation, matricesO(n)
ArraysHashing.java
Two sum, subarray sums, product except self, anagram groups, longest consecutive, top K, cyclic sort, Boyer-Moore, Dutch flag, next permutation, rotations, matrix ops, trapping water
O(n)
  • Pair that hits a target? → Value to index map twoSum
  • Count contiguous subarrays with a sum condition (negatives allowed)? → Prefix sum + frequency map subarraySum
  • Longest subarray with equal 0s and 1s? → Map 0 to -1, first-seen index of each balance findMaxLength
  • Product / aggregate of everything except self? → Left pass then right pass productExceptSelf
  • Top K by frequency in O(n)? → Bucket by frequency topKFrequent
  • Values in 1..n, find missing or duplicate? → Cyclic sort or Floyd on i to a[i] firstMissingPositive
    • 2 more
  • Majority element? → Boyer-Moore vote majorityElement
  • Sort three kinds in place? → Dutch national flag sortColors
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class ArraysHashing {

    // ---------- Two Sum (LC 1): value -> index map, one pass ----------
    static int[] twoSum(int[] a, int target) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> seen = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            Integer j = seen.get(target - a[i]);
            if (j != null) return new int[]{j, i};
            seen.put(a[i], i);
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

    // ---------- Subarray Sum Equals K (LC 560): prefix-sum frequency map ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: count/exists contiguous subarray with a sum (or sum mod, or balance) condition. Works with negatives.
    static int subarraySum(int[] a, int k) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> freq = new HashMap<>();
        freq.put(0, 1);
        int sum = 0, count = 0;
        for (int x : a) {
            sum += x;
            count += freq.getOrDefault(sum - k, 0);
            freq.merge(sum, 1, Integer::sum);
        }
        return count;
    }

    // Subarray Sums Divisible by K (LC 974): key = prefix mod k, normalized to non-negative
    static int subarraysDivByK(int[] a, int k) {
        int[] cnt = new int[k];
        cnt[0] = 1;
        int sum = 0, res = 0;
        for (int x : a) {
            sum = ((sum + x) % k + k) % k;
            res += cnt[sum]++;
        }
        return res;
    }

    // Contiguous Array (LC 525): map 0 -> -1, longest subarray with sum 0 via first-seen index
    static int findMaxLength(int[] a) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> first = new HashMap<>();
        first.put(0, -1);
        int bal = 0, best = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            bal += a[i] == 1 ? 1 : -1;
            Integer j = first.putIfAbsent(bal, i);
            if (j != null) best = Math.max(best, i - j);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Product of Array Except Self (LC 238): left pass, then right pass ----------
    static int[] productExceptSelf(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];
        res[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) res[i] = res[i - 1] * a[i - 1];
        int right = 1;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) { res[i] *= right; right *= a[i]; }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Group Anagrams (LC 49): canonical key = sorted chars (or 26-count signature) ----------
    static List<List<String>> groupAnagrams(String[] strs) {
        Map<String, List<String>> g = new HashMap<>();
        for (String s : strs) {
            char[] c = s.toCharArray();
            Arrays.sort(c);
            g.computeIfAbsent(new String(c), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(s);
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(g.values());
    }

    // ---------- Longest Consecutive Sequence (LC 128): only start counting at sequence heads ----------
    static int longestConsecutive(int[] a) {
        Set<Integer> set = new HashSet<>();
        for (int x : a) set.add(x);
        int best = 0;
        for (int x : set) {
            if (set.contains(x - 1)) continue;
            int len = 1;
            while (set.contains(x + len)) len++;
            best = Math.max(best, len);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Top K Frequent (LC 347): bucket by frequency, O(n) ----------
    static int[] topKFrequent(int[] a, int k) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> f = new HashMap<>();
        for (int x : a) f.merge(x, 1, Integer::sum);
        List<Integer>[] bucket = new List[a.length + 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> e : f.entrySet()) {
            if (bucket[e.getValue()] == null) bucket[e.getValue()] = new ArrayList<>();
            bucket[e.getValue()].add(e.getKey());
        }
        int[] res = new int[k];
        int p = 0;
        for (int c = a.length; c >= 1 && p < k; c--)
            if (bucket[c] != null) for (int x : bucket[c]) if (p < k) res[p++] = x;
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Cyclic sort / index-as-hash: First Missing Positive (LC 41), values in 1..n go to index v-1 ----------
    static int firstMissingPositive(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            while (a[i] > 0 && a[i] <= n && a[a[i] - 1] != a[i]) {
                int t = a[a[i] - 1]; a[a[i] - 1] = a[i]; a[i] = t;
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (a[i] != i + 1) return i + 1;
        return n + 1;
    }

    // Find the Duplicate Number (LC 287): Floyd cycle detection on i -> a[i]
    static int findDuplicate(int[] a) {
        int slow = a[0], fast = a[a[0]];
        while (slow != fast) { slow = a[slow]; fast = a[a[fast]]; }
        slow = 0;
        while (slow != fast) { slow = a[slow]; fast = a[fast]; }
        return slow;
    }

    // ---------- Boyer-Moore majority vote (LC 169) ----------
    static int majorityElement(int[] a) {
        int cand = 0, cnt = 0;
        for (int x : a) {
            if (cnt == 0) cand = x;
            cnt += x == cand ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return cand;
    }

    // ---------- Dutch National Flag (LC 75) ----------
    static void sortColors(int[] a) {
        int lo = 0, mid = 0, hi = a.length - 1;
        while (mid <= hi) {
            if (a[mid] == 0) swap(a, lo++, mid++);
            else if (a[mid] == 2) swap(a, mid, hi--);
            else mid++;
        }
    }

    // … swap(): helper hidden
    private static void swap(int[] a, int i, int j) { int t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; }

    // ---------- Next Permutation (LC 31) ----------
    static void nextPermutation(int[] a) {
        int i = a.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i >= 0) {
            int j = a.length - 1;
            while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
            swap(a, i, j);
        }
        for (int l = i + 1, r = a.length - 1; l < r; l++, r--) swap(a, l, r);
    }

    // ---------- Rotate Array (LC 189): three reversals ----------
    static void rotate(int[] a, int k) {
        int n = a.length;
        k %= n;
        rev(a, 0, n - 1); rev(a, 0, k - 1); rev(a, k, n - 1);
    }

    // … rev(): helper hidden
    private static void rev(int[] a, int l, int r) { while (l < r) swap(a, l++, r--); }

    // ---------- Matrix: rotate 90 clockwise (LC 48), spiral (LC 54), set zeroes O(1) (LC 73) ----------
    static void rotateMatrix(int[][] m) {
        int n = m.length;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) { int t = m[i][j]; m[i][j] = m[j][i]; m[j][i] = t; }
        for (int[] row : m) rev(row, 0, n - 1);
    }

    static List<Integer> spiralOrder(int[][] m) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        int top = 0, bot = m.length - 1, left = 0, right = m[0].length - 1;
        while (top <= bot && left <= right) {
            for (int j = left; j <= right; j++) out.add(m[top][j]);
            top++;
            for (int i = top; i <= bot; i++) out.add(m[i][right]);
            right--;
            if (top <= bot) { for (int j = right; j >= left; j--) out.add(m[bot][j]); bot--; }
            if (left <= right) { for (int i = bot; i >= top; i--) out.add(m[i][left]); left++; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    static void setZeroes(int[][] m) {
        int R = m.length, C = m[0].length;
        boolean row0 = false, col0 = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) if (m[0][j] == 0) row0 = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) if (m[i][0] == 0) col0 = true;
        for (int i = 1; i < R; i++) for (int j = 1; j < C; j++) if (m[i][j] == 0) { m[i][0] = 0; m[0][j] = 0; }
        for (int i = 1; i < R; i++) for (int j = 1; j < C; j++) if (m[i][0] == 0 || m[0][j] == 0) m[i][j] = 0;
        if (row0) for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) m[0][j] = 0;
        if (col0) for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) m[i][0] = 0;
    }

    // ---------- Reservoir sampling (uniform pick from a stream of unknown length) ----------
    static int reservoirPick(int[] stream, Random rnd) {
        int pick = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < stream.length; i++) if (rnd.nextInt(i + 1) == 0) pick = stream[i];
        return pick;
    }

    // Fisher-Yates shuffle
    static void shuffle(int[] a, Random rnd) {
        for (int i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) swap(a, i, rnd.nextInt(i + 1));
    }

    // ---------- Trapping Rain Water (LC 42): two pointers on the lower wall ----------
    static int trap(int[] h) {
        int l = 0, r = h.length - 1, lm = 0, rm = 0, water = 0;
        while (l < r) {
            if (h[l] < h[r]) { lm = Math.max(lm, h[l]); water += lm - h[l]; l++; }
            else { rm = Math.max(rm, h[r]); water += rm - h[r]; r--; }
        }
        return water;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Prefix-sum maps must be seeded with {0: 1} (or {0: -1} for earliest index).
  2. Negative mod: normalize with ((x % k) + k) % k.
  3. Longest consecutive: only start counting at sequence heads to stay O(n).

29 — ARRAYSVARIANTS.JAVA

Arrays: Counting & Chunking

Harder array problems are rarely about the array itself: they are counting pairs (merge sort or Fenwick), choosing chunk boundaries (prefix max vs suffix min), or linear-time sorting when keys are bounded.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Merge-sort countingCount pairs i < j with a value relationO(n log n)
Prefix / suffix scanChunks, unsorted window, sightseeing pairO(n)
Boyer-Moore kElements appearing more than n/k timesO(n)
Sign markingDuplicates / missing in range 1..nO(n), O(1) space
Radix / counting sortBounded keysO(n + range)
ArraysVariants.java
Circular max subarray, majority II, find duplicates, count of range sum, reverse pairs, max chunks I and II, longest mountain, best sightseeing pair, bounded-max subarrays, shortest unsorted subarray, max width ramp, two non-overlapping subarrays, radix sort, counting sort, 3-way quicksort
Counting & chunking
  • Maximum subarray on a circular array? → max(linear best, total - linear worst) maxSubarraySumCircular
  • Elements appearing more than n/k times? → Boyer-Moore with k - 1 candidates, then verify majorityElementII
  • Values in 1..n, find duplicates in O(1) space? → Negate a[|x| - 1] as a visited mark findDuplicates
  • Count pairs i → Merge sort counting (or Fenwick on ranks) countRangeSum
  • Most independent chunks to sort? → Cut where prefix max <= suffix min maxChunksToSortedII
  • Furthest pair with a[i] → Decreasing stack of left candidates, sweep right maxWidthRamp
    • 1 more
  • Sort integers in linear time? → Radix or counting sort radixSort
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class ArraysVariants {

    // ---------- Maximum Sum Circular Subarray (LC 918): max(best linear, total - worst linear) ----------
    // Edge case: if every element is negative, total - min = 0 would mean an empty subarray, so return the linear max.
    static int maxSubarraySumCircular(int[] a) {
        int total = 0, curMax = 0, curMin = 0, best = a[0], worst = a[0];
        for (int x : a) {
            curMax = Math.max(x, curMax + x);
            curMin = Math.min(x, curMin + x);
            best = Math.max(best, curMax);
            worst = Math.min(worst, curMin);
            total += x;
        }
        return best < 0 ? best : Math.max(best, total - worst);
    }

    // ---------- Majority Element II (LC 229): Boyer-Moore with two candidates, then verify ----------
    static List<Integer> majorityElementII(int[] a) {
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 1, n1 = 0, n2 = 0;
        for (int x : a) {
            if (x == c1) n1++;
            else if (x == c2) n2++;
            else if (n1 == 0) { c1 = x; n1 = 1; }
            else if (n2 == 0) { c2 = x; n2 = 1; }
            else { n1--; n2--; }
        }
        n1 = n2 = 0;
        for (int x : a) { if (x == c1) n1++; else if (x == c2) n2++; }
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (n1 > a.length / 3) res.add(c1);
        if (n2 > a.length / 3) res.add(c2);
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Find All Duplicates (LC 442): negate a[|x| - 1] as a visited mark (values in 1..n) ----------
    static List<Integer> findDuplicates(int[] a) {
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : a) {
            int i = Math.abs(x) - 1;
            if (a[i] < 0) res.add(i + 1); else a[i] = -a[i];
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Merge-sort counting family: count pairs (i < j) with a relation, while merging ----------
    // RECOGNIZE: "count pairs i < j with a[i] vs a[j] condition" -> merge sort (or Fenwick over ranks).
    // Count of Range Sum (LC 327): pairs of prefix sums with lower <= p[j] - p[i] <= upper
    static int countRangeSum(int[] a, int lower, int upper) {
        long[] p = new long[a.length + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) p[i + 1] = p[i] + a[i];
        return sortCount(p, 0, p.length - 1, new long[p.length], lower, upper);
    }

    // … sortCount(): helper hidden
    private static int sortCount(long[] p, int lo, int hi, long[] tmp, int lower, int upper) {
        if (lo >= hi) return 0;
        int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
        int count = sortCount(p, lo, mid, tmp, lower, upper) + sortCount(p, mid + 1, hi, tmp, lower, upper);
        int l = mid + 1, r = mid + 1;
        for (int i = lo; i <= mid; i++) { // both halves are sorted: slide two windows over the right half
            while (l <= hi && p[l] - p[i] < lower) l++;
            while (r <= hi && p[r] - p[i] <= upper) r++;
            count += r - l;
        }
        int i = lo, j = mid + 1, k = lo;
        while (i <= mid && j <= hi) tmp[k++] = p[i] <= p[j] ? p[i++] : p[j++];
        while (i <= mid) tmp[k++] = p[i++];
        while (j <= hi) tmp[k++] = p[j++];
        System.arraycopy(tmp, lo, p, lo, hi - lo + 1);
        return count;
    }

    // Reverse Pairs (LC 493): i < j and a[i] > 2 * a[j]
    static int reversePairs(int[] a) { return rp(a.clone(), 0, a.length - 1, new int[a.length]); }

    // … rp(): helper hidden
    private static int rp(int[] a, int lo, int hi, int[] tmp) {
        if (lo >= hi) return 0;
        int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
        int count = rp(a, lo, mid, tmp) + rp(a, mid + 1, hi, tmp);
        int j = mid + 1;
        for (int i = lo; i <= mid; i++) {
            while (j <= hi && (long) a[i] > 2L * a[j]) j++;
            count += j - (mid + 1);
        }
        int i = lo, r = mid + 1, k = lo;
        while (i <= mid && r <= hi) tmp[k++] = a[i] <= a[r] ? a[i++] : a[r++];
        while (i <= mid) tmp[k++] = a[i++];
        while (r <= hi) tmp[k++] = a[r++];
        System.arraycopy(tmp, lo, a, lo, hi - lo + 1);
        return count;
    }

    // ---------- Max Chunks To Make Sorted (LC 769, permutation of 0..n-1): chunk ends where max == index ----------
    static int maxChunksToSorted(int[] a) {
        int chunks = 0, max = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { max = Math.max(max, a[i]); if (max == i) chunks++; }
        return chunks;
    }

    // Max Chunks II (LC 768, arbitrary values): chunk boundary when prefix max <= suffix min
    static int maxChunksToSortedII(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length;
        int[] sufMin = new int[n + 1];
        sufMin[n] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) sufMin[i] = Math.min(sufMin[i + 1], a[i]);
        int chunks = 0, max = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { max = Math.max(max, a[i]); if (max <= sufMin[i + 1]) chunks++; }
        return chunks;
    }

    // ---------- Longest Mountain in Array (LC 845): one pass, up-run then down-run ----------
    static int longestMountain(int[] a) {
        int best = 0, i = 1, n = a.length;
        while (i < n) {
            while (i < n && a[i] == a[i - 1]) i++;
            int up = 0, down = 0;
            while (i < n && a[i] > a[i - 1]) { up++; i++; }
            while (i < n && a[i] < a[i - 1]) { down++; i++; }
            if (up > 0 && down > 0) best = Math.max(best, up + down + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Best Sightseeing Pair (LC 1014): maximize (a[i] + i) + (a[j] - j) with i < j ----------
    static int maxScoreSightseeingPair(int[] a) {
        int bestLeft = a[0], best = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j < a.length; j++) {
            best = Math.max(best, bestLeft + a[j] - j);
            bestLeft = Math.max(bestLeft, a[j] + j);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Subarrays with Bounded Maximum (LC 795): count with max in [left, right] ----------
    static int numSubarrayBoundedMax(int[] a, int left, int right) {
        int res = 0, lastBad = -1, lastGood = -1; // lastBad: last index > right; lastGood: last index in range
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] > right) lastBad = i;
            if (a[i] >= left) lastGood = i;
            res += Math.max(0, lastGood - lastBad);
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Shortest Unsorted Continuous Subarray (LC 581): compare with sorted, or scan both ends ----------
    static int findUnsortedSubarray(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length, end = -1, start = 0, max = a[0], min = a[n - 1];
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            max = Math.max(max, a[i]);
            if (a[i] < max) end = i;
            min = Math.min(min, a[n - 1 - i]);
            if (a[n - 1 - i] > min) start = n - 1 - i;
        }
        return end == -1 ? 0 : end - start + 1;
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Width Ramp (LC 962): decreasing stack of left candidates, sweep right to left ----------
    static int maxWidthRamp(int[] a) {
        Deque<Integer> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (st.isEmpty() || a[st.peek()] > a[i]) st.push(i);
        int best = 0;
        for (int j = a.length - 1; j >= 0 && !st.isEmpty(); j--)
            while (!st.isEmpty() && a[st.peek()] <= a[j]) best = Math.max(best, j - st.pop());
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Sum of Two Non-Overlapping Subarrays (LC 1031) of lengths L and M ----------
    static int maxSumTwoNoOverlap(int[] a, int L, int M) { return Math.max(twoLen(a, L, M), twoLen(a, M, L)); }

    // … twoLen(): helper hidden
    private static int twoLen(int[] a, int first, int second) {
        int n = a.length;
        int[] p = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i + 1] = p[i] + a[i];
        int bestFirst = 0, best = 0;
        for (int i = first + second; i <= n; i++) {
            bestFirst = Math.max(bestFirst, p[i - second] - p[i - second - first]); // best "first" window ending before the second
            best = Math.max(best, bestFirst + p[i] - p[i - second]);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Radix sort (LSD, base 10, non-negative ints): when n is large and the key range is bounded ----------
    static void radixSort(int[] a) {
        int max = 0;
        for (int x : a) max = Math.max(max, x);
        int[] out = new int[a.length];
        for (long exp = 1; max / exp > 0; exp *= 10) {
            int[] cnt = new int[10];
            for (int x : a) cnt[(int) (x / exp % 10)]++;
            for (int d = 1; d < 10; d++) cnt[d] += cnt[d - 1];
            for (int i = a.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) out[--cnt[(int) (a[i] / exp % 10)]] = a[i]; // backward keeps it stable
            System.arraycopy(out, 0, a, 0, a.length);
        }
    }

    // ---------- Counting sort for a small value range ----------
    static void countingSort(int[] a, int maxValue) {
        int[] cnt = new int[maxValue + 1];
        for (int x : a) cnt[x]++;
        int k = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v <= maxValue; v++) while (cnt[v]-- > 0) a[k++] = v;
    }

    // ---------- Quick sort with three-way partition (handles many duplicates) ----------
    static void quickSort3(int[] a) { qs(a, 0, a.length - 1, new Random(7)); }

    // … qs(): helper hidden
    private static void qs(int[] a, int lo, int hi, Random rnd) {
        if (lo >= hi) return;
        int pivot = a[lo + rnd.nextInt(hi - lo + 1)], lt = lo, i = lo, gt = hi;
        while (i <= gt) {
            if (a[i] < pivot) swap(a, lt++, i++);
            else if (a[i] > pivot) swap(a, i, gt--);
            else i++;
        }
        qs(a, lo, lt - 1, rnd);
        qs(a, gt + 1, hi, rnd);
    }

    // … swap(): helper hidden
    private static void swap(int[] a, int i, int j) { int t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Use long for prefix sums and for 2 * a[j] comparisons in pair counting.
  2. Circular max subarray: if all values are negative the answer is the linear max, not total - min.
  3. Count pairs during merge, before merging, while both halves are still sorted.

30 — SLIDINGWINDOWPOINTERS.JAVA

Sliding Window & Two Pointers

Variable window: grow right, shrink left while invalid. "Longest valid" updates after the shrink; "shortest valid" updates inside the shrink loop; "count subarrays" uses atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1). Two pointers on sorted data move the pointer that cannot improve.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Variable windowLongest / shortest substring or subarray under a conditionO(n)
Exact-K countingatMost(k) minus atMost(k - 1)O(n)
Fixed windowAnagrams, max averageO(n)
Two pointersSorted pair sums, 3Sum, container, dedupe, mergeO(n) after sort
SlidingWindowPointers.java
Longest unique substring, character replacement, minimum window, min subarray length, K distinct, exactly K, ones III, anagrams, 2Sum/3Sum, container, dedupe, merge
O(n)
  • Longest substring / subarray satisfying a condition? → Variable window; update after shrinking lengthOfLongestSubstring
  • Shortest window covering requirements? → Variable window; update inside the shrink loop minWindow
  • Count subarrays with exactly K distinct? → atMost(K) minus atMost(K - 1) subarraysWithKDistinct
  • Window of fixed size, anagram check? → Fixed window with a difference counter findAnagrams
  • Sorted array, pair or triple sums? → Sort + two pointers threeSum
  • Maximize area between two walls? → Move the shorter wall maxArea
    • 1 more
  • Product / sum below a bound with positives? → Variable window with running product or sum numSubarrayProductLessThanK
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class SlidingWindowPointers {

    // ===== VARIABLE WINDOW SKELETON =====
    //   for (r...) { add a[r]; while (window invalid) { remove a[l]; l++; } update answer }
    // "longest valid"  -> update after the shrink loop.
    // "shortest valid" -> update INSIDE a while (window valid) loop that shrinks.
    // "count subarrays with property" -> atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1).

    // Longest Substring Without Repeating (LC 3)
    static int lengthOfLongestSubstring(String s) {
        int[] last = new int[128];
        Arrays.fill(last, -1);
        int l = 0, best = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < s.length(); r++) {
            char c = s.charAt(r);
            if (last[c] >= l) l = last[c] + 1;
            last[c] = r;
            best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Longest Repeating Character Replacement (LC 424): window valid iff len - maxFreq <= k (maxFreq never shrinks)
    static int characterReplacement(String s, int k) {
        int[] cnt = new int[26];
        int l = 0, maxFreq = 0, best = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < s.length(); r++) {
            maxFreq = Math.max(maxFreq, ++cnt[s.charAt(r) - 'A']);
            if (r - l + 1 - maxFreq > k) cnt[s.charAt(l++) - 'A']--;
            best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Minimum Window Substring (LC 76): shortest window covering all of t
    static String minWindow(String s, String t) {
        int[] need = new int[128];
        for (char c : t.toCharArray()) need[c]++;
        int missing = t.length(), l = 0, bestL = 0, bestLen = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int r = 0; r < s.length(); r++) {
            if (need[s.charAt(r)]-- > 0) missing--;
            while (missing == 0) {
                if (r - l + 1 < bestLen) { bestLen = r - l + 1; bestL = l; }
                if (++need[s.charAt(l++)] > 0) missing++;
            }
        }
        return bestLen == Integer.MAX_VALUE ? "" : s.substring(bestL, bestL + bestLen);
    }

    // Minimum Size Subarray Sum (LC 209): positives only
    static int minSubArrayLen(int target, int[] a) {
        int l = 0, sum = 0, best = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            sum += a[r];
            while (sum >= target) { best = Math.min(best, r - l + 1); sum -= a[l++]; }
        }
        return best == Integer.MAX_VALUE ? 0 : best;
    }

    // Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct (LC 340 / 159 / fruit baskets 904)
    static int lengthOfLongestSubstringKDistinct(String s, int k) {
        Map<Character, Integer> cnt = new HashMap<>();
        int l = 0, best = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < s.length(); r++) {
            cnt.merge(s.charAt(r), 1, Integer::sum);
            while (cnt.size() > k) {
                char c = s.charAt(l++);
                if (cnt.merge(c, -1, Integer::sum) == 0) cnt.remove(c);
            }
            best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Subarrays with exactly K distinct (LC 992) = atMost(K) - atMost(K-1)
    static int subarraysWithKDistinct(int[] a, int k) { return atMostDistinct(a, k) - atMostDistinct(a, k - 1); }

    // … atMostDistinct(): helper hidden
    private static int atMostDistinct(int[] a, int k) {
        if (k < 0) return 0;
        Map<Integer, Integer> cnt = new HashMap<>();
        int l = 0, res = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            cnt.merge(a[r], 1, Integer::sum);
            while (cnt.size() > k) {
                if (cnt.merge(a[l], -1, Integer::sum) == 0) cnt.remove(a[l]);
                l++;
            }
            res += r - l + 1; // every subarray ending at r and starting in [l, r]
        }
        return res;
    }

    // Max Consecutive Ones III (LC 1004): at most k zeros flipped
    static int longestOnes(int[] a, int k) {
        int l = 0, zeros = 0, best = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            if (a[r] == 0) zeros++;
            while (zeros > k) if (a[l++] == 0) zeros--;
            best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Permutation in String (LC 567) / Find All Anagrams (LC 438): fixed window, compare counts
    static List<Integer> findAnagrams(String s, String p) {
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        int m = p.length();
        if (s.length() < m) return res;
        int[] diff = new int[26];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { diff[p.charAt(i) - 'a']--; diff[s.charAt(i) - 'a']++; }
        int nonZero = 0;
        for (int d : diff) if (d != 0) nonZero++;
        if (nonZero == 0) res.add(0);
        for (int r = m; r < s.length(); r++) {
            nonZero += adjust(diff, s.charAt(r) - 'a', 1);
            nonZero += adjust(diff, s.charAt(r - m) - 'a', -1);
            if (nonZero == 0) res.add(r - m + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    // … adjust(): helper hidden
    private static int adjust(int[] d, int i, int delta) {
        int before = d[i] != 0 ? 1 : 0;
        d[i] += delta;
        return (d[i] != 0 ? 1 : 0) - before;
    }

    // Maximum Average Subarray I (LC 643): fixed window sum
    static double findMaxAverage(int[] a, int k) {
        long sum = 0, best;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) sum += a[i];
        best = sum;
        for (int i = k; i < a.length; i++) { sum += a[i] - a[i - k]; best = Math.max(best, sum); }
        return (double) best / k;
    }

    // ===================== TWO POINTERS =====================

    // Two Sum II sorted (LC 167)
    static int[] twoSumSorted(int[] a, int target) {
        int l = 0, r = a.length - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            int s = a[l] + a[r];
            if (s == target) return new int[]{l + 1, r + 1};
            if (s < target) l++; else r--;
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

    // 3Sum (LC 15): sort, fix i, two pointers, skip duplicates
    static List<List<Integer>> threeSum(int[] a) {
        Arrays.sort(a);
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length - 2; i++) {
            if (i > 0 && a[i] == a[i - 1]) continue;
            int l = i + 1, r = a.length - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int s = a[i] + a[l] + a[r];
                if (s < 0) l++;
                else if (s > 0) r--;
                else {
                    res.add(List.of(a[i], a[l], a[r]));
                    l++; r--;
                    while (l < r && a[l] == a[l - 1]) l++;
                    while (l < r && a[r] == a[r + 1]) r--;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    // 3Sum Closest (LC 16)
    static int threeSumClosest(int[] a, int target) {
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int best = a[0] + a[1] + a[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length - 2; i++) {
            int l = i + 1, r = a.length - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int s = a[i] + a[l] + a[r];
                if (Math.abs(s - target) < Math.abs(best - target)) best = s;
                if (s < target) l++; else if (s > target) r--; else return s;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Container With Most Water (LC 11): move the shorter wall
    static int maxArea(int[] h) {
        int l = 0, r = h.length - 1, best = 0;
        while (l < r) {
            best = Math.max(best, Math.min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l));
            if (h[l] < h[r]) l++; else r--;
        }
        return best;
    }

    // Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array (LC 26): read/write pointers
    static int removeDuplicates(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0) return 0;
        int w = 1;
        for (int r = 1; r < a.length; r++) if (a[r] != a[w - 1]) a[w++] = a[r];
        return w;
    }

    // Move Zeroes (LC 283)
    static void moveZeroes(int[] a) {
        int w = 0;
        for (int x : a) if (x != 0) a[w++] = x;
        while (w < a.length) a[w++] = 0;
    }

    // Valid Palindrome (LC 125)
    static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int l = 0, r = s.length() - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            while (l < r && !Character.isLetterOrDigit(s.charAt(l))) l++;
            while (l < r && !Character.isLetterOrDigit(s.charAt(r))) r--;
            if (Character.toLowerCase(s.charAt(l++)) != Character.toLowerCase(s.charAt(r--))) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    // Merge sorted arrays in place from the back (LC 88)
    static void merge(int[] a, int m, int[] b, int n) {
        int i = m - 1, j = n - 1, k = m + n - 1;
        while (j >= 0) a[k--] = i >= 0 && a[i] > b[j] ? a[i--] : b[j--];
    }

    // Subarray Product Less Than K (LC 713)
    static int numSubarrayProductLessThanK(int[] a, int k) {
        if (k <= 1) return 0;
        int l = 0, res = 0;
        long prod = 1;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            prod *= a[r];
            while (prod >= k) prod /= a[l++];
            res += r - l + 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Sliding window with negatives breaks the "shrink" logic; use prefix sums + map or a deque instead.
  2. 3Sum: skip duplicates for the fixed element AND after recording a triple.
  3. Minimum window: track missing as a count so validity is O(1) per step.

31 — WINDOWSVARIANTS.JAVA

Windows: Beyond the Basics

The extra patterns: window over a subsequence, window over fixed-size words, fix a parameter and slide (unique count 1..26), complement windows, and a TreeSet window for value-closeness.

PatternUse caseComplexity
Forward match + backward tightenWindow containing t as a subsequenceO(nm)
Fix distinct countEvery char at least k timesO(26 n)
Complement windowTake from both endsO(n)
atMost differenceExactly k odd / distinctO(n)
TreeSet windowValues within t, indices within kO(n log k)
WindowsVariants.java
Minimum window subsequence, concatenation of all words, longest substring with at least k repeats, max card score, nice subarrays, reduce x to zero, turbulent subarray, almost-duplicate with TreeSet, k-sum recursion, substrings with a, b and c, fixed-window vowels, most frequent element after k increments
Window variants
  • Window must contain t as a subsequence? → Forward match then backward tighten minWindowSubsequence
  • Every character in the window appears at least k times? → Fix distinct count 1..26, slide longestSubstringAtLeastK
  • Take items from both ends? → Complement: slide a window in the middle maxScoreCards
  • Exactly k odd numbers or distinct values? → atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1) numberOfSubarrays
  • Values within t and indices within k? → TreeSet floor / ceiling over the window containsNearbyAlmostDuplicate
  • 4-sum or k-sum? → Recursive kSum down to two pointers fourSum
// … imports hidden
import java.util.*;

public class WindowsVariants {

    // ---------- Minimum Window Subsequence (LC 727): shortest window of s containing t as a SUBSEQUENCE ----------
    // Greedy forward to match all of t, then backward to tighten the left edge, then continue just after that left edge.
    static String minWindowSubsequence(String s, String t) {
        int n = s.length(), m = t.length(), bestLen = Integer.MAX_VALUE, bestStart = -1, i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int j = 0, k = i;
            while (k < n && j < m) { if (s.charAt(k) == t.charAt(j)) j++; k++; }
            if (j < m) break; // t no longer fits
            int end = k; // exclusive
            j = m - 1;
            k--;
            while (j >= 0) { if (s.charAt(k) == t.charAt(j)) j--; k--; }
            k++;
            if (end - k < bestLen) { bestLen = end - k; bestStart = k; }
            i = k + 1;
        }
        return bestStart == -1 ? "" : s.substring(bestStart, bestStart + bestLen);
    }

    // ---------- Substring with Concatenation of All Words (LC 30): window over word-sized steps, one pass per offset ----------
    static List<Integer> findSubstring(String s, String[] words) {
        List<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>();
        int w = words[0].length(), cnt = words.length, n = s.length();
        Map<String, Integer> need = new HashMap<>();
        for (String x : words) need.merge(x, 1, Integer::sum);
        for (int off = 0; off < w; off++) {
            Map<String, Integer> have = new HashMap<>();
            int l = off, matched = 0;
            for (int r = off; r + w <= n; r += w) {
                String word = s.substring(r, r + w);
                if (!need.containsKey(word)) { have.clear(); matched = 0; l = r + w; continue; }
                have.merge(word, 1, Integer::sum);
                matched++;
                while (have.get(word) > need.get(word)) { // too many of this word: shrink from the left
                    have.merge(s.substring(l, l + w), -1, Integer::sum);
                    l += w;
                    matched--;
                }
                if (matched == cnt) res.add(l);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Longest Substring with At Least K Repeating Characters (LC 395): fix the number of unique chars (1..26) ----------
    static int longestSubstringAtLeastK(String s, int k) {
        int best = 0;
        for (int uniq = 1; uniq <= 26; uniq++) {
            int[] cnt = new int[26];
            int l = 0, unique = 0, atLeastK = 0;
            for (int r = 0; r < s.length(); r++) {
                if (cnt[s.charAt(r) - 'a']++ == 0) unique++;
                if (cnt[s.charAt(r) - 'a'] == k) atLeastK++;
                while (unique > uniq) {
                    if (cnt[s.charAt(l) - 'a'] == k) atLeastK--;
                    if (--cnt[s.charAt(l) - 'a'] == 0) unique--;
                    l++;
                }
                if (unique == uniq && unique == atLeastK) best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Points You Can Obtain from Cards (LC 1423): take from the ends = leave a window of n - k ----------
    static int maxScoreCards(int[] a, int k) {
        int n = a.length, total = 0, window = 0;
        for (int x : a) total += x;
        int w = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i < w; i++) window += a[i];
        int minWindow = window;
        for (int i = w; i < n; i++) { window += a[i] - a[i - w]; minWindow = Math.min(minWindow, window); }
        return total - minWindow;
    }

    // ---------- Count Number of Nice Subarrays (LC 1248): exactly k odds = atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1) ----------
    static int numberOfSubarrays(int[] a, int k) { return atMostOdd(a, k) - atMostOdd(a, k - 1); }

    // … atMostOdd(): helper hidden
    private static int atMostOdd(int[] a, int k) {
        if (k < 0) return 0;
        int l = 0, odds = 0, res = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            odds += a[r] & 1;
            while (odds > k) odds -= a[l++] & 1;
            res += r - l + 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Minimum Operations to Reduce X to Zero (LC 1658): longest middle window with sum = total - x ----------
    static int minOperationsToZero(int[] a, int x) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int v : a) total += v;
        long target = total - x;
        if (target < 0) return -1;
        int l = 0, bestLen = -1;
        long sum = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            sum += a[r];
            while (sum > target && l <= r) sum -= a[l++];
            if (sum == target) bestLen = Math.max(bestLen, r - l + 1);
        }
        return bestLen == -1 ? -1 : a.length - bestLen;
    }

    // ---------- Longest Turbulent Subarray (LC 978) ----------
    static int maxTurbulenceSize(int[] a) {
        int best = 1, up = 1, down = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] > a[i - 1]) { up = down + 1; down = 1; }
            else if (a[i] < a[i - 1]) { down = up + 1; up = 1; }
            else { up = down = 1; }
            best = Math.max(best, Math.max(up, down));
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Contains Duplicate III (LC 220): window of the last k values in a TreeSet, floor / ceiling probe ----------
    static boolean containsNearbyAlmostDuplicate(int[] a, int indexDiff, int valueDiff) {
        TreeSet<Long> window = new TreeSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            long x = a[i];
            Long f = window.floor(x + valueDiff);
            if (f != null && f >= x - valueDiff) return true;
            window.add(x);
            if (i >= indexDiff) window.remove((long) a[i - indexDiff]);
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------- kSum generalization (LC 18 / 4Sum): sort, recurse down to the two-pointer base case ----------
    static List<List<Integer>> fourSum(int[] a, int target) {
        Arrays.sort(a);
        return kSum(a, target, 0, 4);
    }

    // … kSum(): helper hidden
    private static List<List<Integer>> kSum(int[] a, long target, int start, int k) {
        List<List<Integer>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (start == a.length) return res;
        long avg = target / k;
        if (a[start] > avg || a[a.length - 1] < avg) return res; // prune: sorted extremes cannot reach the average
        if (k == 2) {
            int l = start, r = a.length - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                long s = (long) a[l] + a[r];
                if (s < target || (l > start && a[l] == a[l - 1])) l++;
                else if (s > target || (r < a.length - 1 && a[r] == a[r + 1])) r--;
                else res.add(new ArrayList<>(List.of(a[l++], a[r--])));
            }
            return res;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (i > start && a[i] == a[i - 1]) continue;
            for (List<Integer> sub : kSum(a, target - a[i], i + 1, k - 1)) {
                sub.add(0, a[i]);
                res.add(sub);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Number of Substrings Containing All Three Characters (LC 1358): for each right end, count valid lefts ----------
    static int numberOfSubstrings(String s) {
        int[] last = {-1, -1, -1};
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            last[s.charAt(i) - 'a'] = i;
            res += 1 + Math.min(last[0], Math.min(last[1], last[2])); // lefts 0..min(last) all contain a, b and c
        }
        return res;
    }

    // ---------- Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Length k (LC 1456): fixed window ----------
    static int maxVowels(String s, int k) {
        int cur = 0, best = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if ("aeiou".indexOf(s.charAt(i)) >= 0) cur++;
            if (i >= k && "aeiou".indexOf(s.charAt(i - k)) >= 0) cur--;
            if (i >= k - 1) best = Math.max(best, cur);
        }
        return best;
    }

    // ---------- Frequency of the Most Frequent Element (LC 1838): sort, window where cost to raise all to a[r] <= k ----------
    static int maxFrequency(int[] a, int k) {
        Arrays.sort(a);
        long sum = 0;
        int l = 0, best = 1;
        for (int r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
            sum += a[r];
            while ((long) a[r] * (r - l + 1) - sum > k) sum -= a[l++];
            best = Math.max(best, r - l + 1);
        }
        return best;
    }
}

Pitfalls

  1. Window of a subsequence cannot use counts: use the forward-then-backward greedy.
  2. Words of fixed length: run one pass per offset 0..w-1.
  3. Exactly k = atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1); handle k - 1 < 0.
